Two Degrees Below Zero: In a bearish market, there’s flexibility in managing shorts entered on rebounds. You don’t have to stop out all at once on the first breakout, only for the price to quickly fall again—causing unnecessary losses. Here are a few short-term defensive strategies for reference:

A. Cover low, re-short higher (commonly called a T): For example, ETH found support near 2000 last night and rebounded. The rebound was weak, so I opened an initial short at 2055. Today, the 12-hour downward momentum has weakened, with resistance near 2106, so you can simply wait and add to the short around 2106. This would bring the average entry price to about 2082. If last night’s low of 2003 rebounds to 2106, that’s a 103-point rebound—already close to the limit of a one-day bounce. After a 103-point rebound, a retracement of at least 38%-50% would put the price at 2106-39=2068. In other words, even if it rebounds to 2106, it should at least retest 2068, allowing the short position with an average entry of 2082 to exit at a profit. If the rebound doesn’t reach 2106, you probably won’t need to add to the position; save that opportunity for a break below 2000, since a second test of 2000 could easily break through. So where should you defend? The defense is against the risk of a sustained rebound after the next day’s open. The first resistance above 2000 is 2112-2136, so defend around 2136. A break above 2136 could take the price to the first resistance on the 2-day line at 2160. Since 2136 is also close to 2160, you can reduce the position by 25-30% at 2136 and add it back at 2160.

B. Manual step-by-step position reduction: If you opened an initial ETH short at 2055, there’s usually little liquidation risk on the initial position. The rebound is also weak, and the price could retest lower at any time. So once the price rebounds above your average entry, you can gradually reduce the position manually at market, selling 5% every 20 points—for example, reduce by 5% at 2075 and 2095. Reduce 5% at 2075 and place an order to buy back at 2095; reduce 5% at 2095 and place an order to buy back at 2115. Continue until the price turns and starts retesting lower. In a typical market, ETH’s one-day rebound is around 100-120 points. Reducing 10% of the initial position during a 100-point rebound keeps losses small while slightly improving the average entry price. A retracement of 40-50% of the day’s rise is enough to make a profit easily. Because the initial position is small, when the rebound is weak, gradually reducing a little and re-shorting higher can quickly keep your cost in line with the market price. When the price starts to retest lower, you can lock in profits in real time. Of course, if the rebound suddenly gains strength, close 50% or the entire position and wait to re-enter short at the next resistance.

C. Reduce via limit orders: If you opened an initial short at 2055 and the price still has some room to move up, add to the position in batches at 2087 and 2106, then set a stop-loss at 2106 for the initial 2055 short. This removes the initial position opened at the lowest price, bringing the average entry to (2087+2106)/2=2096. Then place an order to add at 2136, with a 25% stop-loss order at 2136. This brings the average entry to around 2102. Since 2112-2136 is a resistance zone, even without an accelerated decline, the price should at least retest 2082-2055. So the profit from the pullback can cover the cost of defending the position. If the decline extends a little further, the profit will grow accordingly. #ETH #Futures

零下二度：在趋势偏空的行情里，反弹空的防守很灵活，不是一股脑的一突破就止损，而一损很快又会跌下来，这样就产生了不必要的损耗。有几种短线上防守的方法可以供各位参考：

A、去低补高法（俗称的T）：比如eth昨晚在2000附近获得支撑反弹，昨晚反弹很弱，接了2055的头仓空，而今天12小时下跌动能减弱，阻力在2106附近，那么可以直接等2106附近正常补空。补空后均价就到了2082左右，而昨晚的最低点2003若反弹到2106已经反弹了103点，已经算是一个单日反抽的极限。反弹103点，至少回测38%-50%即2106-39=2068。也就是说即使反弹到2106也至少会回测一下2068，那么成本均价2082的空单也能获利走。而如果最高反弹到不了2106，那么基本就不需要补仓就可以应对了，把补仓的机会留给跌破2000的时候。因为若二探2000是很可能跌破的。那么防守在哪里？防守应对的是第二天开盘连续反弹的风险。因为2000上方的第一个压力位是2112-2136。所以防守2136附近，突破2136就可能到2日线的第一阻力2160。而2136离2160又很近，2136的防守就可以做减仓25-30%，在2160补回。

B、手动递进减仓法：如果eth在2055空的头仓，头仓一般没有什么强平，反弹也不强，随时可能再回踩下来。那么当反弹超过成本均价，就可以循环渐进手动市价每隔20点去减仓5%，即2075、2095各减5%，2075减5%，挂在2095接回，2095减5%，挂在2115接回。直到拐头开始回踩为止。寻常行情，eth的单日反弹100-120点左右算的，100点反弹里减掉头仓的10%，损耗较小，还保持了均价的一点点提高。单日涨幅回撤40-50%就能轻松盈利。因为头仓车头轻，反弹不强时，一点点递减补高，能迅速保持成本跟市价持平，当开始回踩，就能实时锁定利润。当然，如果反弹突然变猛，就直接50%或全部平仓等待下个压力位重新再空。

C、委托减仓法：如果2055接的头仓空，此时还有往上推进一点的可能，那么就直接在2087、2106分批补仓，然后将2055的头仓设在2106止损。这样去掉了最低价的头仓，成本均价就变成（2087+2106）/2=2096。再在2136委托补仓，在2136委托25%的止损。这样成本就到了2102附近，而2112-2136是压力位，即使没有加速下跌的情况下，也会至少回踩2082-2055。所以回撤产生的利润也能覆盖防守的损耗。当跌幅在扩大一点，利润就随之扩大。 #ETH #合约

一、现价在哪
现价离下轨只有几块钱，处在通道最下沿。这个位置有两种读法：超跌后的技术性反弹窗口，或者下轨被破、通道继续下移。别急着站队，看收盘。

1）2056 附近：日线下轨。日线收盘守住，说明卖压暂时衰竭；连续两根日线收在下面，趋势还会往下走。

3）1848：区间低点。下轨一旦失守，这里是下一个会被测试的位置。

三、失效条件
日线连续收破 2056，我就认错，不再讲反弹，转为防守。反过来，日线收回 2259 以上，偏弱的判断作废。

Wallets & Security | How do you look up a transaction using a block explorer?
Failed transactions on Ethereum are still included in blocks. Their status is shown as failed, and the Gas already spent is usually not refunded.
A block explorer only reads public on-chain data, so you don’t need to connect a wallet to look up a transaction. Pages that require you to connect a wallet before you can view anything are likely fake.
To check the transfer of $ETH , use an Ethereum block explorer and search for the transaction hash or address to view the record. Currently 2067.41.
Avoid making large transactions over public Wi-Fi, and remember to keep your phone’s operating system up to date.

translatedData.subTitle:
Many people find it hard to cut their losses because they see a stop-loss as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
gets in the way. Try looking at it differently: a stop-loss is insurance you've bought in advance, and the premium is that small loss.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn't who gets it right more often, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The most level-headed traders I've seen are quicker than anyone to admit when they're wrong. Because they know that whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn't matter; what matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. The next time your hand hesitates when it's time to cut a loss, tell yourself
this: It's an entry ticket, not a verdict.

translatedData.content:
ETHA’s quarterly report unpacked | Q3 buying and rising ETH prices both boosted net assets | Still waiting for fund flow data today

My view is that institutional channels have a long-term role, but last quarter’s growth should not be mistaken for buying today. The Q3 10-Q for the iShares Ethereum Trust ETF (ETHA), filed with the U.S. SEC, shows that the fund’s ETH holdings rose from about 2.6955 million at the end of June to about 3.6757 million at the end of September. It bought about 1.1913 million ETH during the quarter, sold about 209,400 ETH to meet redemptions, and used another roughly 1,670 ETH to pay expenses. During the same period, 52.64 million shares were created and about 9.2533 million were redeemed, for a net increase of about 43.3867 million shares. These figures need to be considered together to explain the rise in holdings and net expansion in fund shares; looking only at “1.19 million ETH bought” would overlook redemptions and expenses.

The quarterly report also includes a figure that is easy to misread: the fund’s net assets grew from about $4.293 billion at the end of June to about $9.900 billion at the end of September, an increase of about 130.61%. The report explicitly states that one of the main reasons was that ETH’s reference price rose from $1,593.01 to $2,693.88 over the same period, a gain of about 69.11%, along with an increase in shares outstanding. A doubling of net assets does not mean that net inflows doubled, nor can it be used to predict ETH’s price movement over the coming week. Creations and redemptions of spot ETF shares transmit demand for funds from traditional markets to custodial ETH holdings, but price movements can also inflate or reduce the dollar value of those assets. Distinguishing “changes in shares” from “changes in valuation” is a boundary that must be maintained when assessing institutional flows.

The market’s current reaction does not support chasing prices directly. At the time of checking, ETH/USDT on Binance was around $2,068, down about 2.48% over 24 hours, with a high of $2,125.22 and a low of $2,006.00. Farside reported combined net outflows of about $184.6 million from ETH spot funds on November 9; on November 10, most funds on the page were still marked as unreported, so the provisional total should not be treated as complete market data. In other words, the expansion shown in the Q3 report and this week’s pressure on fund flows can both be true. A short-term recovery would be more convincing if ETH regains and holds above $2,125; if it falls below $2,006 and fails to recover, that would invalidate the rebound thesis. If complete fund flow data continue to show outflows, I will lower my expectations for a recovery in fund flows.

If I were trading myself, I would stay out for now, keeping only a conditional spot long in consideration. The entry trigger is for ETH to move above $2,125 and hold that level on a retest, while also waiting for at least one day of relatively complete fund flow data that no longer shows deterioration. If those conditions are met, I would invest no more than 3% of total capital, set an initial target of $2,200, sell half upon reaching it, and close the rest if the price falls back below $2,125. The initial stop-loss would be below $2,006. If the price first falls below $2,006 or funds continue to see significant net outflows, I would cancel the plan. No leverage, and I won’t present a plan whose conditions have not been met as a completed trade. #ETH

This is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

content:
ETHA季报拆开看｜三季度增持与币价上涨共同推高净值｜今天仍等资金数据

我的态度是承认机构渠道的长期作用，但不把上季度的增长误当成今天的买盘。美国SEC收录的iShares Ethereum Trust ETF（ETHA）三季度10-Q显示，基金持有ETH从6月末约269.55万枚增至9月末约367.57万枚。季度内买入约119.13万枚，用于赎回份额的卖出约20.94万枚，另有约1670枚用于支付费用。同期份额新设5264万份、赎回约925.33万份，净增加约4338.67万份。多组数据合起来，才能说明持仓增加与基金份额净扩张；单看“买入119万枚”会忽略赎回及费用。

季报还有一个容易被误读的数字：基金净资产从6月末约42.93亿美元增至9月末约99.00亿美元，增幅约130.61%。报告明确指出，主要原因之一是同期ETH参考价格从1593.01美元升至2693.88美元，涨约69.11%，另有流通份额增加。净资产翻倍不等于净流入资金翻倍，也不能拿它预测接下来一周的ETH走势。现货ETF的份额创设与赎回，会把传统市场资金需求传递到托管ETH持仓；但价格变动也会放大或压低美元计价资产规模。区分“份额变化”和“估值变化”，是看机构资金时必须守住的边界。

市场当前的反应并不支持直接追高。扫描时币安ETH/USDT约2068美元，24小时跌约2.48%，高2125.22、低2006.00。Farside的11月9日ETH现货基金合计净流出约1.846亿美元；11月10日页面大多数基金仍显示缺报，暂列的合计数字不能当作完整市场数据。也就是说，三季度季报呈现的扩张与本周资金压力可以同时成立。若ETH重新站稳2125，短线修复才更有说服力；若跌破2006且无法收回，反弹判断被推翻。后续基金完整流量若继续流出，我会降低对资金回暖的预期。

如果是我自己交易，目前不参与，方向只保留现货条件式试多。入场触发是ETH站上2125美元并回踩守住，同时等待至少一日较完整的基金流量数据不再恶化；满足后最多投入总资金3%，第一目标看2200美元，触及后减半，余仓若跌回2125便平仓。初始止损放在2006美元下方；若价格先跌破2006或基金持续显著净流出，取消计划。不开杠杆，也不会把未触发的方案写成已成交。#ETH

以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

📰 Should Exchange Hot Wallets Have a Hard Cap? What Is CertiK Afraid Of?

Crypto security firm CertiK recommends that all exchanges set a dollar-equivalent limit for their hot wallets (online storage). This isn’t the first time this idea has been raised, but CertiK specifically points out that cold storage (offline storage) is only part of the security picture—not the whole solution. This could mean regulatory or technical standards are due for an upgrade, and every player in the industry will have to weigh the implications.

Why does this news matter?

CertiK isn’t making this up on a whim. Cold storage is indeed secure, but if hackers attack an online exchange directly, even extensive cold storage can’t save funds that have already been stolen. The industry generally uses a mix of hot and cold wallets, but there’s no uniform standard for the ratio. CertiK’s proposed hard cap is essentially an attempt to use firm rules to force exchanges to take hot wallet security more seriously. Behind this is a crisis of user trust pushing the industry to change—after all, what user would want 80% of their money sitting in an online wallet that could be hacked at any moment?

Market impact

In the short term, this news may spook a lot of risk-averse users. If exchanges really do make adjustments, operating costs could rise, and some smaller exchanges may not be able to cope. But over the long term, this would set rules for the entire industry and boost investor confidence. After all, no one wants to keep their money somewhere that doesn’t even have strict hot wallet safeguards. If regulators see this kind of industry self-regulation, they may be all the more pleased. That said, with Bitcoin and Ethereum currently at $73,770 and $2,066.25, respectively, users care most about prices. Can security concerns temporarily take precedence over price fluctuations?

Trading approach

This news may slightly dampen market sentiment, but it isn’t a decisive factor. Exchange security has long been a familiar topic, and CertiK has simply put its point more forcefully this time. The recent downtrends in $BTC  and $ETH  (down 1.37% and 2.66%, respectively) have already absorbed much of the security-related concern. If an exchange runs into trouble as a result, the impact would be significant; if this becomes a new industry standard and is implemented, it could bolster long-term confidence. This means there’s no need to overreact in the short term, but exchange security could become an important consideration for institutional allocation going forward.

This assessment is invalidated if an exchange suffers a large-scale withdrawal failure due to a hot wallet hack.

📰 交易所热钱包要戴硬顶？CertiK到底在怕什么

加密货币安全公司 CertiK 建议，所有交易所的热钱包（线上存储）必须设置美元等值上限。这不是第一次提这个观点，但 CertiK 明确指出冷存储（线下存储）只是安全的一部分，不能当全部。这意味着监管或技术标准可能要升级了，所有玩家都得掂量掂量。

为什么这条新闻重要？
CertiK 这番话不是拍脑袋的。冷存储确实安全，但要是黑客直接攻击线上交易所，冷存储再多也救不了已经被盗走的钱。目前行业普遍做法是冷热钱包混合用，但比例没统一标准。CertiK 提出硬顶，本质是想用硬性规定逼着交易所更重视热钱包的安全。这背后是用户信任危机在倒逼行业变革——想想看，哪个用户愿意自己的钱 80% 存在随时可能被盗的线上钱包里？

对市场的影响
短期内，这消息会吓唬一票胆小的用户。交易所如果真的要调整，可能会增加运营成本，部分小交易所甚至可能撑不住。但长期看，这是给整个行业立规矩，利好投资者信心。毕竟，谁也不愿把钱存在一个连热钱包保护措施都不严格的地方。监管层要是看到这种行业自律行为，可能还会更乐见其成。但话说回来，比特币和以太坊目前 $73,770 和 $2,066.25，用户最关心的还是价格，安全这事儿能暂时压过价格波动吗？

操作思路
这条新闻对市场情绪可能有轻微压制，但不是决定性的。毕竟交易所安全一直是个老生常谈的话题，CertiK 这次只是把话说得更硬气了些。$BTC 和 $ETH 近期的下跌趋势（分别 -1.37% 和 -2.66%）已经把安全担忧消化了不少。如果未来有交易所因此出事，那影响会大；要是变成行业新标准并得到实施，那对长期信心有提振。这意味着短期内不必过度反应，但交易所安全这块儿，未来可能要成为机构配置的重要考量维度了。

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Rolling Over Your Position: Fortune at Risk, or a Fast Track to Liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
The term “rolling over your position” has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: use a small amount of capital and several times leverage to ride a big trend, roll it over a few times,
and turn it into dozens of times your original capital. Today, let’s talk about what those stories leave out.

【How rolling over a position works】Instead of cashing out unrealized gains, you use them as risk capital for a new position and keep trading,
It’s basically using the market’s money to add leverage. As long as the trend continues, compounding is incredible; when it stops, unrealized gains can go from
a gain of several dozen points to zero in just one or two massive bearish candles.

【The mathematical reality】Rolling over your position is essentially about “being right repeatedly.” If your win rate is 60% each time, the odds of being right four times in a row
are only 13%. Behind every post about doubling your money overnight are 99 people who have already deleted their accounts.

title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

translatedData.title: Pyramid Scaling: How to Add to a Winning Trend Trade Without Wiping Out
translatedData.subTitle:
If you’ve got the trend right and want to add to your position, how should you do it? Going all-in from the start and adding as much as possible with unrealized profits is a surefire way to end up on the liquidation list.
A regular. The right approach is called pyramid scaling.

【Principle】Add less each time than you did the time before. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first confirmed pullback,
Confirm again, then add 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position should be. Keep most of your cost basis low so you can withstand a pullback.

【Why the opposite is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, adding more and more at the top) means that your
average cost is concentrated at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn a profit into a loss. Once you lose your nerve, your trading goes completely off the rails.

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Rolling Your Position: Fortune Favors the Bold, or a Fast Track to Liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
“Rolling your position” has been all the rage lately. The stories are always the same: use a small amount of capital and several times leverage to ride a big trend, then roll it over a few times
and turn it into dozens of times your original stake. Today, let's talk about what those stories leave out.

【What does rolling your position mean?】Instead of cashing out unrealized gains, you treat them as risk capital for a new position and keep trading,
It's like using the market's money to add leverage. As long as the trend continues, compounding is incredible; once it stops, your unrealized gains can go from
up dozens of percentage points to zero in just one or two big down candles.

【The mathematical reality】Rolling your position is essentially “getting it right repeatedly.” If your win rate is 60% each time, the odds of getting it right four times in a row
are only 13%. Behind every post about doubling your money overnight are 99 people who have already deleted their accounts.

title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

translatedData.title: Pyramiding: How to add to a trend trade as it rises without getting burned
translatedData.subTitle:
You’ve got the trend right and want to add to your position—but how? Going in heavy right away and then adding all your floating profits is a recipe for ending up on the liquidation list.
a familiar face. The right approach is called pyramiding.

【The principle】Add less each time than you did the previous time. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first pullback is confirmed,
Confirm the move, then add 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position should be. Keep most of your cost basis low, so you can withstand a pullback.

【Why the reverse is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, adding more and more at the top) means your
average cost is concentrated at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn your profits into losses. Once you lose your nerve, your whole strategy falls apart.

title: Market Momentum and Speculative Rotation: Analytical Outlook on EDGE and RHEA RIVER
subTitle:
The broader digital asset market is navigating a turbulent phase characterized by heightened volatility, macro sensitivity, and divergent capital flows. While established benchmark assets like Bitcoin and Ethereum have faced heavy liquidations and cautious sentiment across social channels, speculative activity remains vibrant in emerging and niche corners of the market. High-beta plays and newly trending assets continue to capture outsized attention as traders rotate capital away from stagnant positions. Within this fast-evolving environment, active market participants are closely monitoring emerging trends, specifically focusing on the performance dynamics of EDGE,RHEA RIVER.

### Why Are EDGE and RHEA RIVER Drawing Attention?

Speculative interest often concentrates where short-term momentum decouples from broader macro hesitation. As major assets experience choppy consolidation, retail and algorithmic traders routinely seek out decentralized listings and emerging trending pairs. The spotlight currently centered around EDGE stems from rotation into lower-profile tokens where liquidity velocity can quickly trigger swift price discoveries.

Similarly, RHEA RIVER has surfaced on trader radars as part of thematic narratives and active search trends. In environments where large-cap assets face localized drawdowns, smaller-cap tokens like RHEA RIVER often benefit from sudden surges in community engagement, on-chain volume, and speculative chatter. Both EDGE and RHEA RIVER represent the type of agile, volatile assets that momentum traders track when looking for sharp market swings, particularly during sessions where established assets fail to produce definitive directional trends.

### Key Risks to Consider

Trading emerging assets and low-liquidity trending tokens entails distinct vulnerabilities that market participants must recognize:

1. **Liquidity Depth and Slippage**: Unlike high-cap networks with multi-million-dollar order book depth, trending niche tokens often feature sensitive liquidity pools. Sudden market-order executions can cause massive slippage, making entries and exits difficult during high-volatility spikes.
2. **Aggressive Mean Reversion**: When a token gains rapid visibility purely through trending lists, early momentum participants often take swift profits. Assets like EDGE and RHEA RIVER can see abrupt pullbacks if buying pressure fails to sustain consistent volume after the initial surge.
3. **Macro Headwinds and Sentiment Spillover**: As observed across major liquidations in headline crypto assets, sudden downturns in overall market confidence can drain liquidity from speculative alts first, leaving late entrants exposed to sharp downside drawdowns.

### What Traders Should Watch Next

For those evaluating EDGE and RHEA RIVER over the upcoming sessions, disciplined execution and objective data monitoring will be paramount. Key factors to track include:

- **Sustained Trading Volume vs. Turnover**: Check whether 24-hour turnover reflects authentic, distributed participation across independent wallets or if volume is heavily concentrated among a handful of active accounts.
- **Order Book Stability**: Gauge whether bid support deepens on pullbacks. Healthy consolidation for EDGE and RHEA RIVER requires persistent bids rather than thin liquidity walls that evaporate under selling pressure.

ETH funds see net outflows of about $551 million this month | Spot rebounds | I’m waiting for 2,091 to hold

My stance is cautiously bullish in the short term, but I’ll only take a low-risk entry after confirmation. I just checked Binance Square’s Trending Topics and Most Searched: BTC fund outflows are a hot topic, and ETH is also on the six-hour trending search list. What’s really worth checking is ETH’s own fund flow data, rather than applying BTC’s figures directly. Farside lists U.S. spot Ethereum funds as having combined net outflows of about $551.1 million from November 2 to 10. On November 10, total net outflows were only $1.3 million, but flows differed by product: ETHB saw about $1.1 million in inflows, TETH saw $400,000 in outflows, and Grayscale ETH saw $2 million in outflows. Opposing flows among different products on the same day show that saying “institutions have all exited” is an oversimplification.

The time boundaries of the fund flow data matter too. In Farside’s current table, the entries for each fund on November 11 are still dashes. The displayed total of 0.0 simply reflects that the breakdown has not yet been filled in; it cannot be reported as zero subscriptions or redemptions having actually occurred that day. The previous day’s $1.3 million in net outflows also shouldn’t be conflated with ETH’s total market capitalization or exchange trading volume. Fund subscriptions and redemptions affect exposure in traditional investment accounts, but spot markets, perpetual futures, staking, and on-chain activity all influence prices as well; a single net flow figure cannot explain every minute-by-minute move. The Ethereum Foundation’s latest blog post is still discussing EIP-8037/8038 compatibility issues in Glamsterdam testing, the Hoodi upgrade has been postponed, and a mainnet timeline has yet to be determined. So today’s rebound cannot be explained as “the new upgrade has already been implemented.”

The market’s actual reaction: at the time of writing, Binance ETHUSDT was around $2,076.54, up about 2.77% in 24 hours, with a range of $2,011.96 to $2,090.63. The price has recovered from its lows but remains below the intraday high. Its coexistence with net fund outflows this month suggests that short-term buyers are providing support, while also reminding me not to treat one night’s rebound as confirmation that the long-term fund flow trend has reversed. The key level is whether ETH can hold above around $2,091, and whether it can hold $2,050 on a pullback. If it breaks above $2,091 but quickly falls below $2,050, my bullish view is invalidated; a further break below $2,012 would largely negate the short-term recovery.

I’ll also watch whether BTC holds its own breakout level and whether subsequent breakdowns of ETH fund flows show sustained improvement. If inflows are limited to a small amount in one product while the overall table continues to show net outflows, there’s little evidence to support claims of institutional money returning. If fund flows improve and the price holds above the upper end of the range, the case will be more solid. The fact that U.S. October CPI rose 0.4% month over month continues to affect interest rate expectations. Risk assets such as ETH are especially sensitive to changes in liquidity, so macro repricing cannot be ignored.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t chase the price now. The only direction I’d consider is a long position in unleveraged spot, with a planned position size of 0.3% of total capital. The entry trigger is two consecutive 15-minute candles closing above $2,091, followed by a pullback that holds above $2,091. If that trigger doesn’t occur, I’ll remain in cash. The first target is $2,130, where I’d reduce the position by half; the second target is $2,180, where I’d close the rest. I’d set a stop loss at $2,048 after entry; if the price breaks out and then falls below $2,091 without reclaiming it, I’d close early. If subsequent fund disclosures show a significant increase in outflows, official upgrade testing reveals another major risk, or the price breaks below $2,050 first, I’ll cancel the plan if it hasn’t been triggered. These are all conditional scenarios, not claims of actual trades or profits.

A counterexample appears in $ETH, where an up hourly direction occurs while volume stays below baseline; here the price also lingers within its range and RSI remains neutral. This shows that direction alone does not dictate volume.

A useful lesson: reassess after the next candle. If volume stays elevated, the price moves beyond the prior range, and RSI tilts higher, the hypothesis gains weight. Otherwise, the spike was likely transient, and the rule should be revised.

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Position Sizing Rule: Why Being Able to Take Losses Helps You Last Longer
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been discussed to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on a single trade
should not exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 USDT in starting capital, 2% means losing no more than 200 USDT on a single trade. After 10 consecutive losses, you’d still have 8,000,
Your account is down only 20%; a few winning trades can bring it back. By contrast, if you go all-in each time and lose 30%,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34%. You’d need to nearly double your money to break even—mathematically, you’re pretty much out of the game.

【How to put it into practice】It’s not “keep your position size under 2%”; it’s “when this trade hits its stop-loss, the amount you lose
must not exceed 2%.” So the right sequence is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work backward to determine the position size.

title: 分批止盈：落袋为安和让利润奔跑，怎么兼得
subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，
这时候这笔单已经不会亏了，心态立刻不一样。第二段：到第二目标位
（比如2倍盈亏比）再减1/3。第三段：剩下的用移动止损跟，跌破均线
或前低就走，让利润自己跑。

【为什么这样】全仓跑早了会拍大腿，全仓拿着经常坐电梯回到解放前。
分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。
手里的利润单，最怕的就是抱着抱着变成亏损单。

translatedData.title: Taking Profits in Stages: How to Lock in Gains While Letting Profits Run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because stop-losses mean cutting fear, while taking profits means cutting greed. The better the market performs, the less you want to
sell—and then when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here's the scaled profit-taking approach I've been using.

【Three stages】Stage one: at the first target (for example, a 1:1 reward-to-risk ratio), sell 1/3 to lock in some gains,
At this point, the trade can no longer lose, and your mindset changes immediately. Stage two: at the second target
(for example, a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio), sell another 1/3. Stage three: let a trailing stop manage the rest; exit if the price falls below the moving average
or the previous low, and let your profits run.

【Why this works】If you sell everything too early, you'll kick yourself. If you hold everything, you often ride the elevator back to square one.

translatedData.content:
The Compute and Debt Test Behind CoreWeave’s Soaring Revenue

U.S. AI cloud provider CoreWeave reported its third-quarter 2026 results amid continued market scrutiny of returns on AI infrastructure investment, financing costs, and the pace of data center expansion. The earnings report brought the focus back to whether demand for computing capacity is actually translating into results. Revenue reached $3.66 billion in the third quarter, up 168% year over year and above market expectations of $3.55 billion. However, net losses widened to $709 million, showing that rapid expansion has not eliminated pressure on profitability and funding.

The key changes also include the company’s forward guidance. CoreWeave raised its full-year revenue forecast to $13.0 billion–$13.3 billion and its adjusted operating profit forecast to $1.275 billion–$1.375 billion. The company said its order backlog had grown to $132.5 billion by the end of the third quarter, up from $104 billion at the end of June, and added that its computing capacity for 2027 was virtually sold out. Its adjusted operating margin rose from 1% in the first quarter and 5% in the second to more than 10% in the third, reflecting improvements in pricing and economies of scale.

However, orders, revenue, and cash flow are not the same thing. AI cloud businesses must first build data centers and purchase GPUs and related equipment, then recognize revenue gradually through multiyear contracts. CoreWeave expects full-year capital expenditures of $37 billion–$39 billion, and its debt stood at nearly $47 billion at the end of the third quarter. A large order backlog can improve visibility into future revenue, but realizing that potential still depends on project delivery, customer performance, access to financing, and the cost of capital. Management said it plans to support future funding needs through customer prepayments, financing from hardware partners, and new financing arrangements backed by customer contracts, while avoiding further issuance of unsecured bonds at current yields.

For crypto markets, this development is more of an indirect indicator of risk appetite and expectations for computing infrastructure than a direct driver of token prices. If demand for AI computing rentals, GPU utilization, and contract pricing continue to improve, the market may reassess the resilience of demand for data centers, power, chips, and high-performance computing assets, and may also pay more attention to assets tied to the AI narrative. Conversely, if financing costs rise, returns on capital expenditures fall short of expectations, or construction and delivery are delayed, valuation pressures on highly leveraged infrastructure models could spill over into volatile technology and crypto assets.

Our editorial view is that these results confirm the continued strength of demand for AI computing capacity, but are not enough on their own to prove that the expansion model has overcome its financial risks. Going forward, more important than quarterly revenue growth will be the rate at which orders convert into revenue, whether margins can be sustained, how capital expenditures align with debt costs, and whether customer prepayments and diversified financing come through as planned.

#CoreWeave revenue grows 168%, stock rises 10% #BTC #ETH #BNB

content:
CoreWeave营收高增背后的算力与债务考验

美国AI云厂商CoreWeave公布2026年第三季度业绩，在市场持续审视AI基础设施投入回报、融资成本和数据中心扩张速度的背景下，这份财报重新把焦点拉回算力需求的实际兑现。公司第三季度营收达到36.6亿美元，同比增加168%，高于市场预期的35.5亿美元；但同期净亏损扩大至7.09亿美元，显示高速扩张并未消除盈利与资金压力。

核心变化还在于前瞻指引。CoreWeave将全年营收预期上调至130亿至133亿美元，调整后运营利润预期上调至12.75亿至13.75亿美元。公司称，截至第三季度末订单储备增至1325亿美元，较6月底的1040亿美元继续增长，并表示2027年算力基本售罄。调整后营业利润率则从第一季度的1%、第二季度的5%，升至第三季度超过10%，反映其定价和规模效应正在改善。

不过，订单、收入与现金流并不是同一概念。AI云业务需要先建设数据中心、采购GPU和配套设备，再通过多年合同逐步确认收入。CoreWeave预计全年资本开支为370亿至390亿美元，截至第三季度末债务接近470亿美元。高额订单储备能提高未来收入能见度，却仍需依赖项目交付、客户履约、融资渠道和资本成本共同兑现。公司管理层表示，计划通过客户预付款、硬件合作方融资及围绕客户合同的新融资安排支持后续资金需求，并避免在当前收益率下继续发行新的无担保债券。

对加密市场而言，这一事件更接近风险偏好与算力基础设施预期的间接变量，而非直接的币价驱动。若AI算力租赁需求、GPU利用率与合同定价持续改善，市场可能重新评估数据中心、电力、芯片和高性能计算资产的需求韧性，也可能提升对AI叙事相关资产的关注度。反过来看，若融资成本上升、资本开支回报不及预期或建设交付延后，高杠杆基础设施模式承受的估值压力也可能传导至高波动科技和加密资产。

编辑观察认为，这份财报验证了AI算力需求仍具强度，但尚不足以单独证明扩张模式已跨越财务风险门槛。后续更值得跟踪的不是单季营收增速，而是订单转收入效率、利润率能否延续、资本开支与债务成本的匹配程度，以及客户预付款和多元融资是否如期落地。

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

translatedData.title: Where Should You Place Your Stop-Loss? How I Choose Between Technical Levels and Percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where you place your stop-loss matters more than whether you set one. Too close, and it gets triggered every day; too far, and one loss can hurt badly.

【Fixed-Percentage Method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. Simple and straightforward, suitable for beginners
to build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop might land right in someone else’s stop-loss cluster.

【Technical-Level Stop-Loss Method】Place it where the structure is invalidated: for a long position, below key support; for a short position,
above resistance. The logic is—if this level breaks, it shows that evidence has emerged that I was wrong.
Adjust your position size based on the stop distance: the wider the stop, the smaller the position, so each trade still risks only a set portion of your capital.

South Korea reaches preliminary consensus on crypto tax delay｜ETH could benefit, but the bill still needs to be seen｜I’m staying on the sidelines around 2055

My stance is cautious and watchful. The trending topic on Binance Square, #SouthKoreaPartiesTentativelyAgreeToDelayCryptoTax, relates to today’s discussion of South Korea’s tax on virtual asset income. South Korea’s Chosun Biz and The Korea Herald report that ruling and opposition lawmakers on the National Assembly’s tax subcommittee say there is preliminary consensus to delay the crypto asset income tax, originally scheduled to begin in 2027, by another two years until 2029. However, details such as the basic deduction, loss carryforwards, and platform reporting requirements are still under discussion, and the relevant amendment to the Income Tax Act still needs further review and approval. For now, it is accurate to say “lawmakers have expressed support and reached a preliminary consensus”; it would be wrong to say South Korea has completed the legislative process or that ETH has gained a new tax-exempt status. I have not yet found an official published document that could serve as a substitute for the final statutory text, so I’m maintaining that distinction.

The possible impact on ETH concerns South Korean investors’ expected tax burden and willingness to trade, not the supply rules of the Ethereum network. If the final bill does delay taxation, some traders may face less pressure to sell early because of the tax deadline. But between policy discussions and actual net spot buying lie the statutory text, implementation rules, trading-platform behavior, and overall risk appetite. South Korea’s tax debate will also not directly change subscriptions and redemptions for US spot ETH funds. Farside’s figures show net outflows of about $1.3 million from US spot ETH funds on November 10; full-day data for the 11th is not yet available. At the very least, this reminds me not to interpret a policy expectation alone as evidence that global institutional funds have already turned to inflows.

The market has not provided strong confirmation either. ETH/USDT on Binance is around $2,055.59, down about 1.29% over 24 hours, with a range of $2,006 to $2,083.28. If the news can independently drive sustained buying, the price would at least need to reclaim the area around $2,083 and hold it. For now, discussion is gaining traction, but the price remains in the middle of its range. I’m setting the upper confirmation zone at $2,084–$2,090, with $2,020 as the first downside level to watch, followed by $2,006. If it breaks below $2,006 and then fails to reclaim it on a rebound, my short-term stabilization view is invalidated. If it moves above $2,090 but quickly falls back below $2,083, I would also count that as a false breakout. The US October CPI and the Fed’s earlier decision to hold rates continue to influence risk assets; ETH cannot be priced based solely on a single piece of news from South Korea.

If I were trading this myself, I would not enter now. I would only consider a small spot long if my conditions are met. I would wait for ETH to close a one-hour candle above $2,090 and hold $2,083 on a retest, while BTC does not simultaneously break below its own 24-hour low. Only then would I use 0.3% of my total capital to test an entry, with no leverage. My first target is $2,125, where I would take half off; the second is $2,160, where I would close the remaining position in stages. I would set a stop-loss at $2,065. Based on an entry around $2,090, the estimated risk to my account for this trade would be about 0.004%. If the retest breaks below $2,083 and the price cannot recover it within an hour, I would exit early. If the subsequent South Korean bill fails to pass or its provisions change significantly, I would cancel this plan based on policy expectations. Until the conditions are met, I’ll remain out of the market; observation should not be presented as profit.

because everyone who was going to get out has already left, yet people are still shorting. Many major rallies in the past have started at times like this.

Russia’s Ministry of Justice today registered the central bank’s directive on organized trading in digital currencies. Local trading venues may open as early as November 22, provided their trading rules are agreed with the regulator beforehand. The pre-opening checklist is detailed: register brokers and central counterparties, retain order and trade records, calculate current and closing prices, and report in line with the standards for existing financial instruments.

Two details are worth noting.

First, the limit. For non-qualified investors, it is 300,000 rubles per year, calculated separately for each intermediary. Switch to another one, and the count starts over. The restriction applies to the channel; there is no overall limit per person.

Second, screening. To decide which coins are eligible, the central bank looks at market capitalization, average daily trading volume, and at least five years of pricing history on foreign exchanges. Local venues must calculate closing prices themselves from day one, but eligibility is still based on historical data from abroad.

Prices are generated domestically, but the reference framework remains abroad.

SharpLink is a publicly traded company that props up its stock price by hoarding ETH. I don’t need to spell out where his interests lie, but bias doesn’t mean he’s wrong, so I checked the numbers.

The strongest point on his list: ETH is disinflationary, and when the network is active it becomes ultrasound deflationary—“Sound, and getting sounder.”

The latest numbers from ultrasound.money (11/11 14:58 UTC):
Since the Merge (2022/9/15), supply has risen from about 120.52 million to about 122.21 million, an increase of about 1.69 million, or +1.40%.
Over the past 30 days, supply increased by about 86,800, an annualized rate of about 0.86%. Over the past 7 days, it increased by about 20,600, an annualized rate of about 0.89%.

Averaged over the more than four years since the Merge, the annual rate is about 0.34%. The current growth rate is more than twice that average. So right now, ETH isn’t getting sounder; issuance is accelerating, and fees burned on-chain are nowhere near enough to offset issuance.

What’s even funnier is that the post cites Vitalik’s long post from 11/8. Vitalik’s exact words: the case for value from burning was never as strong as it seemed; even if burn stays below the breakeven point for a long time, there’s no need to be upset—ETH’s value comes from elsewhere. He reposts Vitalik’s post, then puts the very selling point Vitalik just set aside right back near the top of his list.

I’m not against the SoV argument. Decentralization, censorship resistance, and use as collateral—those are real strengths. But a store of value, simply put, is something you can hold without it losing value. Supply is growing at an annualized rate of nearly 0.9%, and ETH/BTC is still hovering around 0.0279. So when someone says “gold and BTC are great, but ETH takes it a step further,” who most needs to believe that? Shareholders of treasury companies that need retail investors to buy in.

And then there’s the claim that “by the end of 2027 at the latest, or by mid-2028, ETH will be a quantum-resistant, AI-resistant currency.” I’ve noted that dated promise. I’ll come back and check the books then.

#ETH #Ethereum

📊 What Is Open Interest (OI)? A Powerful Indicator Every Crypto Futures Trader Should Understand
$BTC | Open Interest (OI) measures the total number of outstanding futures and options contracts that have not yet been closed or settled. It helps traders understand how much activity and positioning exists in the derivatives market.
🔍 How Does Open Interest Work?
When two traders open a new futures contract, Open Interest increases. When an existing contract is closed, Open Interest decreases. If an existing position simply changes hands, OI may remain unchanged.
📈 How to Read Open Interest:
Price rises + OI rises: New positions are building alongside the upward move, potentially supporting bullish momentum.
Price falls + OI rises: New positions are building during the decline, potentially confirming bearish pressure.
Price rises + OI falls: Falling open positions may indicate short covering.
Price falls + OI falls: Long positions may be closing, suggesting reduced market participation.
⚖️ Open Interest vs. Trading Volume
Trading volume measures how many contracts are traded during a specific period, while Open Interest measures how many contracts remain active at a particular moment. Both indicators provide different insights into market activity.
🔥 Why Does OI Matter?
Traders combine Open Interest with price action, trading volume, funding rates and liquidation data to identify potential market trends, crowded positions and possible volatility.
$ETH | Rising OI does not automatically mean the market is bullish. Every futures contract has both a long and a short side, so OI alone cannot reveal which direction will win.
$BNB | The Key Takeaway: Open Interest helps traders understand market participation, but it should always be used alongside other indicators rather than as a standalone trading signal.
📌 Learn the data, understand the risk, and always DYOR before trading.

$ETH: Analyzing Historical Turnover and Liquidity

$ETH: Does high historical turnover guarantee that current prices can withstand a shift? The current $ETH price sits inside the recorded range while the hourly direction is up.

### Turnover Versus Depth
Many people assume that high daily volume reflects the ease with which a large position can be closed without slippage. This is often a misconception because volume measures historical transactions rather than the resting depth available in the live order book. The observation shows volume is 2.67x baseline, indicating active participation recently. However, these completed trades only describe the past. A mechanism worth considering is the disconnect between how many tokens changed hands and how many limit orders are currently waiting. If many active participants recently exited, the remaining depth might be thinner than the turnover suggest, even with the daily change at -1.26246% and RSI at 49.0.

### Conditional Thinking
A counterexample occurs when high activity is purely driven by small market orders that do not leave behind persistent depth. If the price moves toward resistance 2066.12 on high relative volume, it does not mean the path remains clear for a reversal. A self-check for this idea involves watching how the price behaves if volume drops. If a subsequent hourly candle closes below support 2046.73 on lower volume, it could suggest the previous high turnover was temporary and not backed by thick standing orders. Reassessing the interpretation becomes necessary if a closed candle violates the local range despite the recent activity levels.

Probabilistic market research, not a recommendation or guaranteed return.

title: Exp ratios, liquidity, and custodial security between top spot Bitcoin ETFs like IBIT, FBTC, & BITB
subTitle:
While all spot Bitcoin ETFs give long-term investors price exposure to Bitcoin without managing private keys or wallet security, their underlying market liquidity, custody architecture, and operational cost structures differ substantially.
The main structural features and risk parameters across the top three spot Bitcoin ETFs—iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT), Fidelity Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund (FBTC), and Bitwise Bitcoin ETF (BITB)—compare as follows:

Key Area Breakdown
1. Expense Ratios & Total Cost of Ownership
BITB (0.20%): Bitwise offers a clear cost advantage, undercutting the major Wall Street asset managers by 5 basis points. Over multi-year or multi-decade holding periods, this lower expense ratio reduces overall drag on compounding returns.IBIT & FBTC (0.25%): Both BlackRock and Fidelity match each other at a standard 0.25% net expense ratio. While slightly more expensive than BITB, for short-term or tactical traders, the higher liquidity of IBIT and FBTC can offset this fee difference through tighter bid-ask spreads during market order execution.
2. Liquidity & Trading Dynamics
IBIT (Market Leader): With the largest AUM and highest daily volume among all spot Bitcoin ETFs, IBIT commands the deepest liquidity pool. This minimizes execution slippage for high-volume traders or large block orders, making it the preferred vehicle for institutional desks.FBTC (Strong Second): Features deep secondary market liquidity and robust Authorized Participant (AP) networks. It easily handles retail and mid-sized institutional order flows with minimal price impact.BITB (Sufficient for Retail): While smaller in total volume compared to IBIT, BITB maintains active market-making support that ensures narrow spreads for standard retail allocation sizes.
3. Custodial Security & Infrastructure Architecture
FBTC (In-House / Vertically Integrated): Fidelity is unique among top issuers because it self-custodies its Bitcoin via Fidelity Digital Assets. This removes third-party concentration risk, ensuring Fidelity does not rely on Coinbase for cold storage.IBIT & BITB (Third-Party Custody via Coinbase): Both BlackRock and Bitwise utilize Coinbase Custody Trust Company as their primary institutional vault manager. While Coinbase is the industry standard for institutional cold-storage security and multi-signature key architecture, it introduces counterparty concentration risk since a significant portion of US ETF assets reside under one entity.
Final Verdict: Which One Fits Which Goal?
Choose IBIT if you are an institutional buyer, high-frequency trader, or prioritize maximum liquidity, the tightest bid-ask spreads, and the backing of BlackRock.Choose FBTC if you prefer single-firm vertical integration, want to avoid third-party custodian concentration risk with Coinbase, or manage your portfolio directly within Fidelity.Choose BITB if you are a cost-conscious long-term buy-and-hold investor seeking the lowest ongoing expense ratio from an established crypto-native firm.

translatedData.content:
The key to fixing this Scroll vulnerability is not whether funds were stolen, but how narrow the trust assumptions of the verification contract are. My view is that the risk level is determined mainly by the threshold for triggering the vulnerability, rather than by the technical possibility of exploiting it. This assessment assumes that the role restrictions and forced-mode status described in the source material are accurate.

According to a November 11 report by PANews, Scroll said it received a bug bounty report on November 3 about a vulnerability in the Ethereum mainnet bundle proof verification contract, and registered the patched verification contract for batch version 10 on November 10. The mechanism described in the source material is that an old valid proof could be used with new public inputs, potentially leading to the finalization of arbitrary state roots and withdrawal roots. However, exploiting it would require the permissioned prover role, or forced batch mode to be activated after seven days without finalization.

Based on this, the danger does not lie in “anyone being able to trigger it,” but in the verification contract’s trusted position in finalizing state roots: once someone clears the prover threshold, an invalid state root could be treated as a valid result. Scroll said the vulnerability was not exploited on mainnet; all 748 finalizations while the vulnerable verification contract was active used valid proofs, and forced mode was never activated. Earlier versions of the verification contract were unaffected. These are disclosures from the project, reported by a single media outlet, and have yet to be independently verified further.

In my view, three conditions are worth monitoring: whether forced batching has ever been enabled, whether the prover set is sufficiently decentralized, and whether subsequent audits cover older versions of the contract. If either of the first two conditions changes, the above assessment of a “low likelihood of triggering” will need to be revisited. The source material does not provide complete information on the scope of subsequent audits. This article does not constitute investment advice.

Scroll这次漏洞修复的关键不在“有没有被盗”，而在验证合约的信任前提有多窄。我的判断是：风险等级主要由触发门槛决定，而不是由漏洞本身的技术可能性决定；这个判断成立的前提，是素材所述的角色限制和强制模式状态属实。

据PANews 11月11日报道，Scroll称11月3日收到关于以太坊主网bundle证明验证合约的漏洞赏金报告，11月10日为batch version 10注册修复后的验证合约。素材给出的机制是：旧的有效证明可被用于新的公共输入，进而可能最终确认任意状态根和提款根。但利用它需要具备许可制证明者角色，或在7天未最终确认后开启的强制批处理模式。

据此推断，这个漏洞的危险点不在“任意人可触发”，而在验证合约处于状态根最终确认的信任位置：一旦有人跨过证明者门槛，错误状态根就可能被当作有效结果。Scroll表示漏洞未在主网被利用，漏洞验证合约活跃期间全部748次最终确认均使用正常证明，强制模式从未开启，此前版本验证合约不受影响。这些是项目方披露，单一媒体报道，尚待更多独立验证。

我的观察是，真正值得跟踪的是三个条件：强制批处理是否曾被启用、证明者集合是否足够去中心化、后续审计是否覆盖旧版本合约。若前两项出现变化，上述“低触发概率”的判断就需重估；本次素材未提供后续审计范围的完整信息。本文不构成投资建议。

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本
影响你这笔交易的性价比。

translatedData.title: What Is the Funding Rate? Why Do Longs Have to Pay Shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
There’s one term you can’t avoid when trading perpetual contracts: the funding rate. It’s settled every 8 hours, and it’s a payment between longs and shorts
that they make to each other. The exchange simply collects and distributes the payments; it doesn’t make money from them.

[Mechanism] Perpetual contracts have no expiration date, so how do their prices stay in line with spot prices? The answer is the funding rate:
When the contract price is higher than the spot price (bullish sentiment is strong) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is lower than the spot price (sellers are dominant) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
Money flows between the two sides, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.

title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，
正确的动作是减仓，不是加仓。

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin alert and liquidation
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn’t happen in an instant; it’s a process. Understand how it works, and you’ll know when to act.

[Step 1] Initial margin: The funds required to open a position. For example, at 10x leverage, it’s 10% of the position value.
[Step 2] The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts showing “Insufficient margin” alerts,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position to lower leverage, or add margin.
[Step 3] Maintenance margin level: Once losses eat into the maintenance margin requirement, the system begins partially liquidating your position,
closing part of it first to reduce risk, rather than closing it all at once.

First, what’s the difference between a native coin and a token?
A wrapped token maps an asset 1:1 onto another blockchain or standard. For example, WBTC is an ERC-20 token on Ethereum that represents Bitcoin.
A native coin is the coin built into a blockchain itself, such as BTC on the Bitcoin network, ETH on Ethereum, and BNB on BNB Smart Chain.
Before receiving a token, check the contract address on the project’s official website. Tokens with the same name and ticker aren’t necessarily the same token.
$ETH  is Ethereum’s native coin. Token transfers on Ethereum all require $ETH  to pay gas. Current price: 2056.7.

Why Paraguay's banking collapse is testing the mettle of stablecoins?

Paraguay's Ueno bank collapse forced customers to shift to stablecoins for liquidity, revealing digital banking's vulnerability while highlighting stablecoins' emergency utility.

Ueno bank's failure in Paraguay exposed how fragile traditional banking can be, especially with digital assets. When customers couldn't access their funds, stablecoins stepped in as a stopgap solution. This isn't about replacing banks—it's about showing what happens when people panic and need immediate liquidity that traditional systems can't provide. It's like when a bridge suddenly collapses, and the only way to cross is via a nearby ferry.

对市场的影响
- 短期：This incident might make investors question the safety of digital banking systems, possibly causing a slight flight to stablecoins rather than cryptocurrencies as a whole. The $1.061 price of XRP could see some temporary support from this trend.
- 中期：If this pattern continues, we might see more regulations targeting digital banks to prevent similar meltdowns. Stablecoins themselves might face stricter oversight since they became the go-to solution during the crisis.

我的判断
This event doesn't automatically mean stablecoins are the future of banking, but it proves they're a viable option in emergencies. For stablecoins to gain more traction, they need better integration with traditional systems rather than just being an alternative during crises. If the next major banking crisis happens in a major economy and stablecoins again become the only quick solution, their value could see a more sustained uplift. But if digital banks improve their systems to prevent such meltdowns, stablecoins might just fade back into the background.

If banks develop effective digital safety protocols, this judgment on stablecoins becomes obsolete.

Bitmine reports huge fiscal-year loss｜mainly due to revaluation of holdings｜ETH at $2,053; I’ll wait for stabilization

My stance is cautious. I won’t interpret a loss-making financial report as direct evidence that “a whale just dumped billions of dollars’ worth of ETH.” The exact trending topic #BitmineReports$6.3BFiscal2026Loss has appeared on Binance Square, and Binance News is also discussing it. I checked Bitmine’s SEC 10-K, filed on November 10: for the fiscal year ended August 31, 2026, the company reported a net loss of approximately $6.313 billion, including approximately $6.229 billion in unrealized fair-value losses on digital assets. This is a book revaluation and is not equivalent to spot sales during the period. As of August 31, the company held 5,901,837 ETH, with a fair value of approximately $14.559 billion. In a subsequent announcement on November 9, the company said it held 6,070,092 ETH as of November 8. These figures refer to different dates: the older financial-report holdings should not be passed off as the current balance, and an end-of-period loss alone is not grounds to conclude that the company has liquidated its entire position.

There are two layers to the transmission mechanism. The first is the corporate balance sheet: an ETH decline flows into earnings through fair-value accounting, weighing on the company’s stock valuation and future financing capacity. If financing becomes more difficult, the pace of additional crypto purchases may slow. The second layer is ETH spot supply and demand: it only makes sense to discuss a net supply shock if actual purchases or sales are disclosed, or if there is verifiable on-chain activity. Bitmine’s revenue for the same period was approximately $125 million, far below the scale of the unrealized revaluation, indicating that the financial-report volatility came more from the price of its holdings than from changes in its core business in a single quarter. This is a reminder of the risk exposure, not evidence that a large sell-off has already happened today.

At the time of writing, Binance ETHUSDT was around $2,052.69, down approximately 0.44% over 24 hours, with a range of $2,006 to $2,096.59. The price is in the lower half of the range, and the market has not confirmed a sustained move higher in response to the financial report. In the short term, I’m watching whether the price can hold near $2,006 and reclaim $2,097–$2,110. If it breaks below $2,006 even as discussion of the report intensifies, that would indicate insufficient risk appetite in the market; “book losses aren’t sales” is not a reason to blindly buy the dip. Conversely, if it holds $2,006 and reclaims $2,110 on rising volume, I would reconsider my current wait-and-see stance. If subsequent company filings disclose actual sales or changes in financing, I’ll reassess rather than rely on outdated data.

Bitmine财报巨亏｜主要是持仓重估｜ETH在2053我先等企稳

我的态度是谨慎，不会把一份亏损财报直接解读成“巨鲸刚刚砸出数十亿美元ETH”。币安广场已出现准确热题#BitmineReports$6.3BFiscal2026Loss，币安News也在讨论。核对Bitmine于11月10日提交的SEC 10-K：截至8月31日的2026财年净亏损约63.13亿美元，其中数字资产未实现公允价值损失约62.29亿美元；这是账面重估，不能等同于当期现货卖出。8月31日公司持有5,901,837枚ETH，公允价值约145.59亿美元。公司11月9日的后续公告则称截至11月8日持有6,070,092枚ETH。两个数对应不同日期，不能用旧财报持仓冒充当前余额，也不能只看期末亏损就认定公司已经清仓。

传导机制分两层。第一层是企业资产负债表：ETH下跌会通过公允价值进入损益，压低股票估值和未来融资能力；如果未来融资变难，新增买币速度可能放慢。第二层才是ETH现货供需：只有实际披露购买、出售或链上可验证流动，才有理由讨论净供给冲击。Bitmine同期收入约1.25亿美元，远小于未实现重估的量级，说明财报波动更多来自持仓价格，而不是单一季度的主营业务变化。这是风险敞口的提醒，不是今天已经发生大额卖盘的证据。

写稿时币安ETHUSDT约2052.69美元，24小时跌约0.44%，区间2006至2096.59。价格靠近区间中部偏下，市场并没有对财报给出持续向上的确认。短线我看2006附近能否守住，以及2097至2110能否被收复。若在财报话题升温后仍跌破2006，说明市场风险承受能力不足，不能拿“账面亏损不是卖出”当作盲目抄底理由。相反，如果守住2006并放量收复2110，我会推翻暂时观望的判断。后续若公司新文件披露实际出售或融资变化，也要重新评估，不沿用旧数据。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向仅考虑现货条件多单。入场触发为ETH一小时收在2110上方，回踩2097至2110守住且BTC同步企稳；满足后投入总资金最多0.3%。目标先看2160，到位减半，再看2210，到位再减剩余仓位的一半。初始止损设在2080下方，并按实际成交价将单笔账户损失限制在0.1%以内；若突破后两小时又跌回2097以下，剩余仓位平仓。若没有触发，继续空仓，不把预案写成成交或收益。财报数字要按日期和会计性质拆开看，交易动作则交给验证后的价格。

🤔 Why does Taproot’s CCV let Bitcoin carry state across transactions?

According to CoinTelegraph, Bitcoin’s new OP_CHECKCONTRACTVERIFY (CCV) script lets transactions “remember” previous states, like on-chain robots, enabling complex protocols and compact fraud proofs. Essentially, this is a technical exploration of bringing smart contracts back to the main chain from the Lightning Network after the Taproot upgrade.

Why does this news matter?
Bitcoin upgrades are generally seen as generational technological revolutions, not minor tweaks. The breakthrough with CCV means:
- The root of the issue lies in Bitcoin’s conflicting needs for scalability and smart contracts: the Lightning Network is fast but untrusted, while the main chain is trusted but slow. CCV aims to rebalance this by reworking state management.
- As the industry evolves, Bitcoin is transitioning from “digital gold” to a “tokenized ledger,” and CCV is an infrastructure experiment in that shift. It is in both technical competition and collaboration with recent Ethereum upgrades and enhancements to Solana’s contract capabilities.
- Connection to recent events: Bitcoin transaction fees topped $10 for the first time last month, showing that on-chain activity remains strong. CCV arrives at just the right time, offering a new paradigm for on-chain interactions.

Market impact
The short-term impact of this technological breakthrough may be limited because:
- BTC/ETH prices: The market is currently focused mainly on macro interest rates and regulation. An underlying technology development like CCV is more of a sentiment indicator and is unlikely to directly drive price movements, but it could reinforce the narrative of Bitcoin as a “foundation for the next-generation internet.”
- Market landscape: If CCV is adopted by the mainstream, it could accelerate innovation in Bitcoin applications across DeFi and NFTs, giving it a differentiated advantage over Ethereum.
- Capital flows: Investors may reassess Bitcoin’s long-term value-storage properties, but the amount of capital involved cannot currently be quantified.

💡 Simply put: With this new script, Bitcoin can finally support smart contract interaction logic similar to Ethereum’s on the main chain. This means Bitcoin is trying to address its most fundamental contradiction. If more efficient scaling solutions emerge in the future, such as Layer 2, the market may eventually forget this development.

content:
🤔 为什么Taproot的CCV能让比特币跨交易带状态？

据 CoinTelegraph，比特币新脚本OP_CHECKCONTRACTVERIFY（CCV）能让交易像链上机器人一样"记住"之前的状态，实现复杂协议和紧凑型欺诈证明。这本质是Taproot升级后，把智能合约从闪电网络拉回主链的一次技术探索。

为什么这条新闻重要？
比特币的升级通常被视为技术代际革命，而非小打小闹。这次CCV的突破意味着：
- 根本原因在于比特币对可扩展性和智能合约的矛盾需求——闪电网络速度快但不可信，主链可信但速度慢。CCV试图用状态管理重构这种平衡。
- 在行业周期中，比特币正在经历从"数字黄金"向"通证化账本"的转型，CCV是其中的基础设施尝试。它和近期以太坊升级、Solana合约功能增强存在技术竞合。
- 和近期事件关联：上个月比特币手续费首次突破$10，显示链上活动热度不减，CCV恰逢其时提供了一种新的链上交互范式。

对市场的影响
这种技术突破短期内可能影响有限，因为：
- BTC/ETH价格：目前市场主要关注宏观利率和监管。CCV这种底层技术进展更像是一种情绪指标，不会直接驱动价格波动，但会强化比特币作为"下一代互联网基石"的叙事。
- 市场格局：CCV如果被主流采用，可能加速比特币在DeFi、NFT领域的应用创新，对以太坊形成差异化优势。
- 资金流向：投资者会重新评估比特币的长期价值储存属性，但具体资金量目前无法量化。

💡 简单说：比特币通过这项新脚本，终于能在主链上实现类似以太坊的智能合约交互逻辑。这意味着比特币正在尝试解决自身最核心的矛盾。如果未来出现更高效扩容方案（如Layer2），这项进展可能被市场淡忘。

【ETH’s “store of value” narrative is facing a stress test】

Vitalik has redefined ETH as a store of value, bringing it closer to the question people in the market actually ask than “ultrasound money” does: What are you buying it for? Don’t get excited just yet. ETH is down 11.2% over the past seven days, and the Fear and Greed Index is at 29. Trading volume has surged abnormally, but prices haven’t held up, with bulls and bears still rotating positions.

Bitmine reported a net loss of $6.3 billion for fiscal year 2026 and holds 6.07 million ETH, around 4.97% of the total supply. In practical terms, when prices fall, companies with large holdings take an immediate valuation hit. ETH holders and institutions considering an allocation to ETH will also reassess the risks.

The business logic makes sense, but the bar is high. For ETH to compete with BTC as a store of value, it needs to explain why institutions should allocate to ETH—not just swap in a new slogan. Liquidity, security, and real-world usage also need to prove they can sustain demand through a downturn. Ordinary investors shouldn’t chase the hype. Watch whether the money is being held for the long term, used to buy with borrowed funds, or pulled out as soon as the slogans fade. Watch whether the narrative can translate into sustained demand for asset allocation. Otherwise, it’s just a new wrapper on the same old sell-off.

I think it can make it through a round of sentiment recovery, but it’s unlikely to grow into a bull market just by being redefined. What remains has to be real demand; what doesn’t is just polished FOMO. Are you itching to jump in this time? More afraid of missing out, or of reliving 2017?

title: 逐仓和全仓有什么区别？新手该用哪个？
subTitle:
开合约时会让你选「逐仓」或「全仓」，很多新手随手一点，结果吃了大亏。

【全仓】账户里所有余额都作为保证金。优点：强平价远，不容易被打爆；
缺点：一旦行情极端，亏损可能吃掉你整个账户。它是把所有鸡蛋放在一个
篮子里互相撑着。

【逐仓】只把指定的一笔钱分配给这个仓位。这个仓爆了，最多亏这一份，
不会传染到其他仓位和本金。风险被装进了笼子里。

【我的建议】新手一律逐仓。原因很简单：你还没有能力评估「一笔错单最坏
亏多少」，那就用制度帮你锁定最大损失。等你学会了仓位管理、连续三
个月稳定盈利，再考虑全仓也来得及。市场里活得久，比赚得快重要一百倍。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: What's the difference between isolated margin and cross margin? Which should beginners use?
translatedData.subTitle:
When opening a futures position, you'll be asked to choose “Isolated Margin” or “Cross Margin.” Many beginners just pick one without thinking and end up taking a big loss.

[Cross Margin] All the balance in your account is used as collateral. Advantage: the liquidation price is further away, so you're less likely to get liquidated;
Disadvantage: in an extreme market move, your losses could wipe out your entire account. It's like putting all your eggs in one
All supporting each other in the basket.

[Isolated Margin] Only a specified amount of money is allocated to this position. If this position gets liquidated, you can lose at most that amount,
and the loss won't spread to your other positions or principal. The risk is kept in a cage.

[My recommendation] Beginners should always use isolated margin. The reason is simple: you aren't yet able to assess the worst-case loss from a single bad trade

Understanding Session Liquidity for $FIL

Why does a higher relative volume sometimes feel bullish for $FIL and other times not? A common assumption is that volume above its baseline automatically confirms a strong move. The counterexample to consider is that $FIL can show hourly direction up with volume above baseline, yet the price may still hover inside a recorded range. In this scenario the session liquidity context matters more than the raw volume number.

When volume spikes, it can simply reflect a larger pool of market participants trading without adding directional pressure. If the price remains within support and resistance levels, the extra trades may be absorbed without shifting the baseline. The mechanism is that volume measures activity, not intent; baseline levels provide a reference but do not guarantee momentum.

What could change the reading? A clear break of the local support or resistance would give the volume a directional anchor. Until such a breakout occurs, the observation should be treated as a neutral signal. Traders should reassess by checking whether price has moved beyond the prior range and whether the volume remains consistently above the baseline across multiple sessions. This approach keeps the analysis grounded in observable session liquidity without implying certainty.

title: 爆仓价是怎么算出来的？一文看懂强平逻辑
subTitle:
开了合约之后，App上会显示一个「预估强平价」，这个数字怎么来的？

【简化算法】以10倍做多为例：本金100U，仓位1000U。当亏损吃掉你的保
证金（再扣掉维持保证金要求）时，触发强平。粗略说：全仓模式下，
强平距离 ≈ 1 / 杠杆倍数。10倍≈反向10%，5倍≈20%，20倍≈5%。

【为什么会插针】大波动时很多人集中爆仓，强平单涌向市场进一步砸价格，
形成连环爆——这就是为什么暴跌总带着长长的针。你的止损如果挂在大家
都在挂的位置，就会和他们的强平单一起被扫。

【实用结论】1. 杠杆越高，强平价越贴近现价，一点波动就出局；
2. 止损永远要设在自己的强平价之前，否则你连自己认错的机会都没有；
3. 看到长下影线别急着抄，那可能是别人的强平在给你表演。

Just days after saying banks were increasing their ETF holdings, Citi opens a large FBTC position

Barclays, a major bank, has increased its Bitcoin ETF holdings, and Citi has opened a new FBTC position—another concrete sign that traditional financial institutions are stepping up their crypto investments.

Just days ago, I posted that Barclays had significantly increased its position in BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF, doubling its value. Now, news has emerged that Citi Securities has also opened a $119M position in the Facebook Bitcoin spot ETF (FBTC). Both are Wall Street giants, and this time they’re putting real money into crypto assets: Barclays increased its holdings by 48% to $187M, while Citi went straight in with a $119M position. Traditional finance is moving into crypto assets faster and faster. They used to watch from the sidelines, but now they’re getting directly involved.

Market impact
- Short term: Moves like these by major institutions can directly boost market sentiment. Take Barclays and Citi: these aren’t paper portfolios—they’ve actually bought $306M worth of Bitcoin ETFs. For BTC, this means a steady inflow of new capital. The effect on ETH may lag, but in the long run, ETH and BTC are likely to become increasingly correlated.
- Medium term: This could mark a turning point, with crypto assets moving from the fringes into the mainstream. In the past, it was VCs and private capital driving the market; now Wall Street’s established players are getting involved. The regulatory environment may improve as a result, the industry landscape will change, and more compliant capital will come in.

My take
For now, I’d call this neutral, but leaning optimistic. Banks are mainly drawn to the regulatory window that ETFs provide. As long as that window stays open, they’ll keep increasing their holdings. This may not trigger an explosive rally in the short term, but it could provide support at the bottom. Don’t be too harsh if I’m wrong—I’m only testing the waters with a small position myself. I’m about 70% confident in this view; I’ll leave the other 30% to the market.
