SharpLink discloses exposure to 895,000 ETH | Staking income is not the same as cash flow | I’m waiting for a reclaim of 2104

My stance is to watch ETH cautiously. I don’t treat an increase in holdings reported in a company’s financial statements as a spot purchase made today. In its Q3 filing with the U.S. SEC and company results announcement, SharpLink disclosed total ETH exposure of approximately 892,708 as of September 30 and approximately 895,117 as of November 2. The latter figure includes 603,953 native ETH held directly, plus LsETH, weETH, and wstETH converted according to their redemption ratios. These assets are not all held in spot wallets, so it would also be inaccurate to simply say that the company “bought 895,117 ETH this week.” The company also disclosed staking income of approximately $35.718 million for the first nine months of this year, accounting for about 96.4% of total revenue. However, staking rewards are primarily received as ETH or liquid staking tokens and do not directly translate into an equivalent amount of operating cash flow. Holdings, income, and cash flow must be treated as three separate concepts.

Why does this matter to the market? If corporate treasuries hold and stake ETH over the long term, they could reduce some of the circulating supply and draw more institutional attention to validator yields. But liquid staking tokens still carry redemption, smart contract, custody, and valuation risks, and companies may also change their allocations to meet operating or financing needs. SharpLink’s figure for November 2 is a snapshot at a specific point in time; it does not mean the figure remained exactly the same on November 12. The Q3 report also explains that some staking-related assets are accounted for at cost less impairment, while spot ETH fluctuates at fair value. Reported profits cannot be directly interpreted as cash available to buy more crypto. To confirm that “institutional capital is flowing back in,” I would look more to subsequent SEC holdings updates and sustained net ETF inflows, rather than treating a single company’s historical snapshot as a substitute for market-wide demand.

The market’s actual response has been muted. As of writing, ETH/USDT on Binance is around $2,061.23, up about 0.53% over 24 hours, but down from the intraday high of $2,103.78; the intraday low was $2,042.77. The financial results have been public for several days, so I can’t force a causal link between them and the current price movement. Around 2104 is today’s upper boundary, and around 2043 is today’s lower boundary. A short-term technical recovery would only be confirmed if the price gets back above 2104 and holds that level on a retest. If it breaks below 2043 and remains unable to reclaim it, I would abandon my cautiously steady view and first look for support around the $2,000 round-number level. If the latest ETF trading-day breakdown has not yet been fully disclosed, I won’t treat blank entries in the table as zero inflows.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now; the only direction I’d consider is a small spot long. The entry trigger would be a four-hour close above $2,104, followed by a retest of the $2,100–$2,104 range that holds, with BTC not simultaneously breaking below its own intraday low. If those conditions are met, I’d use no more than 2% of my total capital for a test position, with no leverage. I’d set the initial stop below $2,075 and the first target at $2,140. At that point, I’d take off half and move the protection level for the remaining position up to breakeven. Sharplink披露89.5万枚ETH敞口｜质押收入不等于现金流｜我等2104收复

我的态度是谨慎观察ETH，不把企业财报里的持仓增长直接当成今天的现货买单。Sharplink在向美国SEC提交的三季报及公司结果公告中披露：截至9月30日的ETH总敞口约892708枚，截至11月2日约895117枚。后一个数字包含直接持有的603953枚原生ETH，以及按赎回比例折算的LsETH、weETH和wstETH，不是全部以现货钱包形式持有，更不能简单说“本周增持895117枚”。公司还披露今年前九个月质押收入约3571.8万美元，约占总收入96.4%；但质押奖励主要以ETH或流动性质押代币取得，并不直接形成同额经营现金流。持仓、收益和现金流三个概念必须分开。

为什么这对市场重要？企业财库如果长期持有并质押ETH，可能减少一部分流通供应，也让机构更关注验证者收益；但流动性质押代币仍面临兑换、智能合约、托管和估值风险，企业也可能为了运营或融资需求改变配置。Sharplink披露的11月2日数字是一个时点快照，不代表11月12日仍完全相同。三季报同时说明部分质押相关资产按成本减减值核算，而ETH现货按公允价值波动；财报利润不能直接读成可用于继续买币的现金。若要确认“机构资金回流”，我更看后续SEC持仓更新与ETF持续净申购，而不是用单家公司的历史快照替代全市场需求。

【$2,071 today, around $2,417 a week ago. A month ago, the anchor was the ATH; now it’s down 58.1%】

ETH took a 14.3% hit this week, then rebounded just 1% from yesterday to today. I previously took that small bounce as a sign that “it couldn’t fall any further,” but that wasn’t a reliable read—a 1% gain in 24 hours only means someone is catching the falling knife; it doesn’t mean the trend has reversed. What’s really interesting is sentiment: the Fear & Greed Index is at 29, with a weekly average of 31. Fear is still there, but the price hasn’t made another low. That’s a bit of divergence, not a notice that we’ve hit bottom.

Bitmine’s earnings report is even more striking: a $6.3 billion net loss for the fiscal year and holdings of 6.07 million ETH, equal to 4.97% of the supply. In practical terms, it affects the balance sheets, financing capacity, and market confidence of companies holding large amounts of ETH amid high volatility. I saw this playbook back in 2017—the packaging has changed, but the risk hasn’t gone away.

Deutsche Bank has launched crypto custody services for Bitcoin, Ethereum, and three stablecoins. The business case makes sense: European institutions and companies get one less security concern from having to build their own wallets, and another compliant access point. This is positive for institutional adoption of on-chain assets; it doesn’t mean ETH is about to rise.

So my view has shifted a little this week: I’m no longer focused solely on the market’s reaction around $2,000, but I still won’t translate “institutions are entering” directly into “the rally is starting.” Next week, I’ll first watch whether the rebound has volume and follow-through, and whether major holders like Bitmine continue to add pressure. Afraid to lose, afraid to miss out—that’s the game.

“Fuel costs.” The more congested the network, the more people compete to get their transactions processed, and the higher the gas price (cost per unit of Gas).

have a habit: they do on-chain operations late at night or when the market is quiet. The same operation can cost half as much.

title: Explain how to hedge a crypto portfolio against rising Federal Reserve interest rates using futures
subTitle:
When the Federal Reserve executes or signals rate hikes, real U.S. Treasury yields spike, borrowing liquidity contracts, and institutional risk appetite drops. Because digital assets carry high macro sensitivity—with high-beta tokens like ETH, SOL, and broader altcoins suffering steeper drawdowns than BTC—hedging using derivatives allows you to protect long spot holdings without triggering taxable sell events.
Here is how to structure hedging strategies using Futures/Perpetuals and Options.
1. Hedging with Futures & Perpetual Swaps (Linear Hedges)
Futures and perpetual contracts provide a 1:1 (linear) delta hedge. They are best suited for short-to-medium duration macroeconomic risk windows (e.g., ahead of FOMC rate announcements or hot CPI data releases).
A. Delta-Neutral Short Hedge
Mechanism: Open short positions in futures or perpetuals equal to the dollar value of your spot holdings.Execution Example: If you hold $100,000 in BTC spot, open a 1x leverage short position worth $100,000 on BTC perpetual contracts.Outcome: If a hawkish Fed statement triggers a 15% drop in BTC, your $15,000 spot loss is offset by a $15,000 gain on the short position.
B. Cross-Hedging Altcoin Risk via BTC Shorting
Because altcoins lack deep options liquidity and tend to drop harder than Bitcoin during rate-hike panics (e.g., ETH/SOL dropping 1.3x–1.5x relative to BTC), traders often short BTC futures as a proxy.
Beta Weighting: If your altcoin portfolio worth $50,000 has an average Beta of 1.4 relative to BTC, size your BTC short hedge to $70,000 ($50,000 × 1.4) to account for higher downside sensitivity.
Key Risks & Costs of Futures Hedges:
Funding Rate Drag: In bear market panics, perpetual funding rates flip negative (shorts pay longs). Holding short perps long-term can get expensive.Liquidation Risk: If the market unexpectedly rallies, your short position risks margin liquidation if under-collateralized.
2. Hedging with Options (Convex / Insurance Hedges)
Options offer asymmetric downside protection: they cap your maximum financial loss while leaving your upside potential open if the crypto market defies Fed rate hikes and rallies.
A. Buying Protective Put Options (Pure Downside Insurance)
Mechanism: Purchase out-of-the-money (OTM) Put Options covering key FOMC or CPI dates.Execution Example: With BTC trading at $75,000, buy 30-day expiry $70,000 Strike Put Options.Payoff Structure:If the Fed hikes rates and BTC crashes to $60,000, your put options surge in value, exercising the right to sell at $70,000.If the Fed turns dovish and BTC surges to $90,000, your maximum loss is capped strictly at the option premium paid upfront.
B. The Zero-Cost Collar Strategy (Cost-Neutral Protection)
If option premiums are expensive due to high implied volatility (IV) ahead of Fed meetings, a collar locks in a tight price range for near-zero net cost.

How It Works: The premium received from selling the upside Call option covers the cost of buying the downside Put option.Trade-off: You protect your portfolio from falling below $2,000, but you capped your maximum upside at $2,500.

title: Аналитик увидел на графике Ethereum повтор сценария 2025 года — это путь к $3 300
subTitle:
Ethereum может повторить прошлогодний сценарий, когда после сильной просадки цена быстро пошла вверх. Такой прогноз дал Джеймс Истон, аналитик и макроинвестор.
Он советует покупать $ETH  сейчас, пока монета стоит около $2 089.
Хотите еще эксклюзивных новостей и аналитики? Подписывайтесь на наш телеграм-канал, обсуждайте новости и делитесь мнениями о последних событиях рынка в чате!
Истон опубликовал в соцсети X два графика $ETH . Первый показывает весну и лето 2025 года, второй — последние месяцы 2026 года. По его мнению, цена оба раза двигалась одинаково.
Сначала $ETH падал до минимума и разворачивался. Потом резко рос и несколько недель держался примерно на одном уровне. Затем цена ненадолго обновляла максимум и сразу падала.
В 2025 году это выглядело так. В апреле ETH стоил около $1 400. К маю он подорожал до $2 400–2 750. В июне цена поднялась выше $2 800, а потом упала примерно до $2 150. Просадка от пика составила 26,63%. Уже в июле ETH стоил больше $3 200.

В этом году ETH прошел похожий путь. В июне он опускался примерно до $1 500. В конце августа цена подскочила до $2 350–2 570. Позже она дошла до $2 800 и развернулась. Сейчас ETH стоит $2 089. Это на 26,02% ниже недавнего пика.

«Мы уже видели это кино», — написал Истон. Он ждет очень сильного роста.

Если история повторится, ETH может вырасти до $3 100–3 300, то есть на 50–60% от текущих $2 089. Именно столько монета прибавила в 2025 году.

Истон добавил на графики еще один индикатор. Он показывают, кто сильнее на рынке — покупатели или продавцы. Чем ниже значение, тем дольше актив продавали.

В прошлом году индикатор упал примерно до 34, и после этого ETH начал расти. Сейчас он находится на уровне 31,47, то есть рядом с той же отметкой. Это знак, что продажи подходят к концу.

ETH: Core Developers’ Meeting Today Won’t Vote on Two Gas Proposals | Audit Still Pending Tomorrow | Stay Disciplined Below 2110

My stance is cautious, especially today: don’t misread the meeting agenda as approval of an upgrade. The Ethereum Foundation’s official post, updated November 9, clearly states that the November 12 ACDC meeting covers consensus-layer topics, and EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 are not on the agenda. ChainSecurity and Dedaub’s audit reports are scheduled for release on November 13, followed by a public Q&A on November 16. Findings and next steps will be discussed on November 19, and the Foundation explicitly says no decision has been predetermined. Earlier testing found that the proposed changes to Gas accounting could affect deployed contracts that rely on existing invariants. Four reports have been received, so the Hoodi testnet hard fork has been delayed. This is about compatibility review and testnet scheduling—not a failure on the existing mainnet, and certainly not evidence that today’s meeting will set a mainnet launch date.

The way this affects ETH isn’t as simple as “a meeting brings buying.” A change to Gas accounting rules could alter application execution costs, state access, and the behavior of some non-upgradeable contracts. If the audit calls for specification changes, the timeline could be pushed back further. On the other hand, identifying issues and addressing them during testing helps reduce the likelihood of compatibility risks making it to mainnet. For trading, I’m treating the audit scope on November 13, project responses on November 16, and core developer discussions on November 19 as three separate checkpoints. If any step lacks a clear conclusion, expectations shouldn’t be counted as certain gains in advance. Bitmine’s losses are still a hot topic on the trading feed, but the company’s financial results and protocol testing progress are separate matters. I won’t combine them into a single upgrade catalyst.

The market’s reaction should also be discussed using live prices. When I checked Binance’s ETH/USDT spot 24-hour snapshot, the price was around $2,079.64, up about 0.81% over 24 hours, with a high of $2,103.78 and a low of $2,042.77. The price hasn’t broken above the previous high, suggesting that bulls have managed a recovery but still lack effective confirmation. I’m treating 2110 as the upper level to watch and 2040 as the short-term support zone. If the price spikes before the audit is released but then closes a four-hour candle back below 2100, that upper wick shouldn’t be treated as a breakout. If the audit shows a broader-than-expected impact, or ETH falls below 2040 and fails to reclaim it, my short-term bullish thesis is invalidated. Only if the audit provides a workable path to revisions and the price holds above 2110 would it make sense to discuss further upside.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t chase the price now. I’d only consider a small spot position on a conditional long setup. The trigger would be a four-hour close above 2110, followed by a retest that holds between 2100 and 2110, with confirmation that the official channels have issued no new notice of worsening compatibility issues. I’d then enter in two tranches, risking 1.5% of total capital. I’d take half off at the first target of 2140 and close the rest at 2180. The initial stop would be below 2070, and I’d exit if a four-hour candle closes below that level. If the price still can’t hold above 2110 after 24 hours, I’d close the position proactively. If it breaks below 2040 first, I’d cancel the plan rather than average down. The upgrade timeline is still uncertain; I’d rather miss part of a rally than use speculation about the agenda as a reason to take a large position.

Sources: Ethereum Foundation, “EIP-8037/EIP-8038 Glamsterdam,” updated November 9; Binance ETH/USDT spot 24-hour market data; Farside ETH fund flows by fund. #ETH
This is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

ETH：今日核心开发者会议不表决两项Gas提案｜审计仍待明日｜2110前先守纪律

我的态度是偏谨慎，今天尤其不把会议日程误读成升级获批。以太坊基金会11月9日更新的官方文章明确列出：11月12日的ACDC是共识层议程，EIP-8037和8038不在本次议程；ChainSecurity与Dedaub的审计报告安排在11月13日发布，11月16日还有公开问答，11月19日才讨论发现和下一步，而且官方明确没有预设决定。此前测试发现拟议Gas计费改动可能影响依赖旧有不变量的已部署合约，已收到四份报告，因此Hoodi测试网硬分叉推迟。这里是兼容性审查和测试网安排，不能写成现有主网发生故障，更不能写成今天开会就会确定主网上线日期。

这条信息影响ETH的机制，并不是“会议带来买盘”这么简单。Gas计费规则一旦变化，应用的执行成本、状态访问方式以及某些不可升级合约的行为可能变化；如果审计要求修订规格，时间表就可能继续后移。另一方面，发现问题并在测试阶段停下来处理，有助于降低把兼容性风险带到主网的概率。对交易来说，我把11月13日审计范围、11月16日项目方回应、11月19日核心开发者讨论当作三个独立检查点。任一环节缺少明确结论，预期就不应提前算成确定收益。广场热榜目前仍有Bitmine亏损话题，但该公司财报与协议测试进度是两件事，我不把它们拼成同一条升级利好。

市场已有的反应也要按实时价格讲。我查看币安ETH/USDT现货24小时快照时，价格约2079.64美元，24小时上涨约0.81%，区间高点2103.78、低点2042.77。上涨并未突破前高，说明多头有修复却还缺一次有效确认。我把2110当作上方观察线，2040当作短线防守区。若价格在审计公布前冲高却四小时收盘回落到2100下方，不能把那根上影线当突破；若审计显示影响范围比预期更广，或ETH跌破2040并无法收回，我的短线偏多假设即被推翻。若审计给出可执行修订路径、价格又站稳2110，才有条件讨论延续。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与追价，只考虑现货小仓位条件多单。触发条件是四小时收盘高于2110，随后回踩2100至2110守住，并确认官方没有新的兼容性恶化通报，再以总资金1.5%分两次进场；第一目标2140减半，第二目标2180平掉剩余。初始止损放在2070下方，四小时收盘跌破就执行。若入场后24小时仍站不稳2110，主动平仓；若先跌破2040，取消计划而不是补仓。升级时间尚未确定，我宁愿错过一段涨幅，也不把议程猜测变成重仓理由。

事实来源：以太坊基金会《EIP-8037/EIP-8038 Glamsterdam》11月9日更新；币安ETH/USDT现货24小时行情；Farside ETH基金逐只流量表。#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What's More Important Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own performance. They've got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (your rationale), what went right or wrong (in terms of execution),
and what you'll do differently next time (specific actions). Stick with it for a month, and you'll be amazed to discover that your losses
Your trade log is full of the same mistakes repeated over and over—for example, always reversing your position immediately after a stop-loss,
or never holding on to profitable trades long enough.

The market changes, but your behavior patterns won't change on their own unless you keep an eye on them and work to change them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don't just look at your account balance—review your trade records.

translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | The Five Rules I Keep Beside My Screen—Sharing Them Just as They Are Today
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, people forget every principle, so I wrote them down and stuck them up where I can see them:

1. Write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can’t, don’t enter.
2. Never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
3. Never add to a losing position or average down.
4. After three losing trades in a row, stop for the day. Watch, but don’t trade.
5. Withdraw some of your profits. The money you take out is cash; what you leave behind is peace of mind.

Just five rules, and not one of them is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they misread the market—it’s that their execution fell apart. Let’s keep each other accountable.

While Ethereum ($ETH) remains the undisputed king of smart contracts, a new wave of AI-driven infrastructure is quietly supercharging its ecosystem. Enter Space and Time ($SXT)—a Microsoft-backed, decentralized data warehouse bringing verifiable AI and zero-knowledge (ZK) computing directly to the Ethereum network. 
If you are watching the intersection of AI, Big Data, and DeFi, here is why ETH and SXT make such a powerful combination right now:
🔹 The Foundation: Ethereum ($ETH)
Ethereum is the global settlement layer for decentralized finance, NFTs, and tokenized assets. However, smart contracts on $ETH  have one major limitation: they cannot natively process massive amounts of off-chain data or run complex database queries without sacrificing speed or security.
🔹 The Missing Piece: Space and Time ($SXT)
Built as an ERC-20 token on Ethereum, $SXT solves Web3’s biggest data bottleneck. Using its breakthrough Proof of SQL technology, Space and Time allows developers and AI agents to run complex data queries off-chain and verify the results on-chain using zero-knowledge proofs.
💡 Why Traders & Builders Are Paying Attention:
Trustless AI Integration: AI agents need accurate, tamper-proof data to execute trades and manage DeFi protocols. $SXT  ensures that the data feeding into Ethereum smart contracts cannot be manipulated. Enterprise Backing: With backing from major tech giants like Microsoft and deep integrations with Chainlink and ZK ecosystems, Space and Time bridges traditional enterprise databases with Web3.Strong Token Utility: $SXT isn't just a speculative asset—it is actively used for validator staking, paying for ZK-proven SQL queries, and rewarding data providers across the network. 
📊 The Bottom Line
Ethereum provides the security and liquidity, while Space and Time provides the high-speed, verifiable brainpower for next-generation dApps and AI agents. As AI continues to merge with blockchain, data-verification layers like ($SXT) are becoming essential infrastructure.

I. Price Trend Analysis

As of the early hours of November 12, Beijing time, Ethereum was trading at $2,082, up approximately 1.9% over the past 24 hours. The price rebounded from an intraday low of $2,068 and reached a high of $2,103, showing a moderate overall recovery. On the hourly candlestick chart, the closing prices of the last five hourly candles climbed gradually from $2,077 to $2,091, before slipping back slightly to $2,077, indicating a rally followed by a pullback. In terms of trading volume, turnover peaked at $28.68 million in the second hour, then gradually declined to $15.11 million, suggesting that the rebound’s momentum is fading. On the daily chart, Ethereum has found strong support at the $2,000 level, with buyers stepping in each time the price has tested this area. A short-term bottom appears to be taking shape. However, selling pressure remains heavy near $2,100, and the price needs to break above this level decisively to confirm a trend reversal.

II. Technical Indicator Analysis

Regarding moving averages, the 7-hour moving average at $2,077 is below the current price, while the 25-hour moving average at $2,063 also provides support. The clear gap between the short- and medium-term moving averages and the long-term moving average reflects a still-weak medium- to long-term trend. The Ethereum market is currently divided between institutional accumulation and retail investors waiting on the sidelines. 以太坊市场深度分析：机构吸筹与宏观压力的双重博弈

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间十一月十二日凌晨，以太坊现货报价两千零八十二美元，过去二十四小时内反弹约百分之一点九。价格从两千零六十八美元的日内低点回升，最高触及两千一百零三美元，整体呈现温和反弹走势。从小时级别K线来看，最近五根小时线的收盘价从两千零七十七美元逐步上行至两千零九十一美元后小幅回落至两千零七十七美元，呈现冲高回落的态势。成交量方面，第二小时成交额达到两千八百六十八万美元为日内高峰，随后逐步缩量至一千五百一十一万美元，显示反弹动能有所衰减。从日线维度来看，以太坊在两千美元整数关口获得较强支撑，多次测试该位置后均出现买盘承接，短期底部形态初步成型。然而，两千一百美元附近的抛压依然较重，价格需要有效突破该位置才能确认趋势反转。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七小时均线两千零七十七美元位于当前价格下方，二十五小时均线两千零六十三美元同样提供支撑，但九十九小时均线两千一百三十三美元构成较强上方压力，短中期均线与长期均线之间存在明显差距，反映中长期趋势仍偏弱。MACD指标显示DIFF线已上穿信号线，柱状图连续五小时保持正值，最新读数为正四点零四，虽然动能偏弱但方向向上。RSI六周期指标从七十八点八的高位回落至五十六点一，短期超买压力已得到释放，目前处于中性区域。布林带上轨两千零八十七点七美元与当前价格非常接近，中轨两千零六十六美元提供支撑，带宽持续收窄预示即将出现方向性突破。KDJ指标中K值五十九点七、D值五十九点五、J值五十九点九，三线高度粘合处于中位区域，方向尚不明朗。SuperTrend指标显示阻力位在两千零九十九美元，价格仍低于该位置，趋势信号维持看跌。ATR真实波动幅度为十六点八美元，波动率处于较低水平，市场处于蓄势阶段。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场当前呈现机构吸筹与散户观望的分化格局。从链上数据来看，大型机构持续增持以太坊，其中Seven Sisters累计购入一万零七百九十二个ETH，最近数小时净流入分别达到一千七百七十五万美元和一千四百六十万美元，大额买方占比超过百分之四十五，显示机构资金正在逢低布局。然而，以太坊基金会近期向稳定币转换了两千个ETH，企业买家BitMine也宣布在达到百分之五持仓上限后暂停主动购买，这些供给端的变化给市场带来一定压力。宏观环境与比特币类似，美国通胀数据超预期推升加息预期，风险资产整体承压，以太坊ETF资金流向同样受到关注。技术面来看，以太坊在两千美元上方构建底部的可能性正在增加，但需要有效突破两千一百美元和SuperTrend阻力位两千零九十九美元才能确认多头掌控局面。长期来看，德意志银行推出包含ETH在内的机构托管服务、代币化股票市场规模突破四十亿美元等利好因素，为以太坊的生态价值提供了坚实支撑。投资者应密切关注美联储政策动向和链上资金流向变化，在确认趋势方向前保持谨慎。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Getting Rich Slowly: What Compounding Really Looks Like in Crypto
translatedData.subTitle:
Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly hold on to their gains in this market are the ones who “get rich slowly.”
Do the math: earning just 1% a day adds up to 12 times your money over 250 trading days in a year. At a steady 10% a month,
you’d have 30 times your money after three years. It may not sound exciting, but it has one remarkable advantage: it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling depends on market moves; compounding depends on discipline. You have to wait for the market, but discipline is in your hands. Don't set your goal
as “double my money this week.” Set it as “make no major mistakes this week.” The former is money the market gives you;
the latter is a skill you own. The market opens every day, but only those who preserve their capital get to keep playing.

ETH: Four Glamsterdam Contract Risk Reports | Audit Milestone Approaching | No Chasing Before 2110

My stance is cautiously bullish, but I put protocol security verification ahead of price speculation. In an update on November 9 to the Glamsterdam testing note published by the Ethereum Foundation on November 6, the Foundation stated clearly that developers had received four reports concerning the potential impact of EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 on deployed contracts, and were reviewing them one by one. These two proposals involve how Gas is priced for certain operations and state usage; some legacy invariants that contracts rely on could therefore be broken. Developers have decided to postpone the Hoodi testnet fork while they await the audits and discussion of possible solutions. These “four reports” are potential compatibility clues; they do not mean that four attacks have occurred on mainnet, nor that the upgrade has already gone live on mainnet.

Unlike the previous round, when the focus was only on the “delay,” today I’m more interested in how to judge whether the risk is subsiding. The public schedule provided by the Foundation is to deliver and publish the Dedaub and ChainSecurity reports on November 13, hold a public Q&A on November 16, and discuss the findings and possible specification revisions at the November 19 developers’ meeting, with no decision promised in advance. Contract developers should check whether their contracts rely on any of the listed invariants; traders should distinguish between “an issue was identified and testing paused” and “something has gone wrong on mainnet.” The former could delay the upgrade narrative and weigh on sentiment in the short term, but could also reduce future deployment risks. The ultimate direction will depend on audit coverage, the cost of revisions, and the new schedule. For now, this cannot simply be counted as a realized bearish catalyst or a bullish outcome already delivered.

The market reaction has not given a definitive answer. When I checked ETHUSDT on Binance, it was around $2,079, up about 1.90% over 24 hours, with a range of $2,039.44 to $2,103.78. The price has not continued to fall in a one-way move because of this note, which has been public for several days, but it has also yet to break above the top of the range. Farside’s records show that U.S. spot ETH funds saw a small net outflow of about $1.3 million in total on November 10. The product-level data for November 11 is still incomplete, so the zero currently shown should not be interpreted as confirmation that there were no outflows. ETH’s short-term moves are also affected by overall crypto risk appetite, fund flows, and upgrade expectations; it is not reasonable to attribute a single candlestick to the four reports.

The key levels I’m watching are 2104–2110 as the upside confirmation zone, with 2140 and 2180 to watch only after the price holds above it. On the downside, 2050 and 2039 are support. If the November 13 audit shows that the impact is broader than expected or that there is still no clear path to revisions, and the price also falls below 2039, I’ll abandon my cautiously bullish outlook. If the audit findings are relatively clear and the price holds above 2110, I’ll have more confidence in a rebound. Before the audit results are available, any claim that “the upgrade is back on its original schedule” is just speculation.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t chase the price right now. My only directional setup would be a conditional spot long, with no more than 2.5% of total capital allocated. I would enter in two tranches only if the price holds above 2110 on strong volume, successfully retests it, and there is no new negative mainnet security announcement. The first tranche would use only half of the planned position. I’d sell at least half at 2140, with a target of 2180 for the rest. If the price spikes and then falls back below 2104, I’d reduce the position; if it breaks below 2050, I’d exit the entire position at a stop-loss. If 2039 gives way before I enter, I’ll cancel the plan. If the audit reveals that the risk scope is significantly broader than currently understood, I’ll proactively close any remaining position even if the stop-loss hasn’t been hit. An untriggered plan is just waiting, not a record of a trade.

Sources: Ethereum Foundation Glamsterdam testing note and November 9 update; Farside fund data; Binance ETHUSDT market data. #ETH
This is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

ETH：Glamsterdam四份合约风险报告｜审计节点将近｜2110前不追

我的态度是谨慎偏多，但把协议安全验证放在价格想象之前。以太坊基金会11月6日发布的Glamsterdam测试说明，在11月9日更新中明确：开发者已收到四份关于已部署合约可能受EIP-8037、EIP-8038影响的报告，正在逐一核查。这两项提案涉及部分操作与状态使用的Gas计价方式；某些合约依赖的旧不变量可能被打破。因此开发者决定暂缓Hoodi测试网分叉，等待审计和方案讨论。这里的“四份报告”是潜在兼容性线索，不等于四起已发生的主网攻击，也不表示升级已经在主网上线。

与上一轮只看“延期”不同，今天我更关注如何判断风险是否收敛。基金会给出的公开时间表是11月13日交付并发布Dedaub与ChainSecurity报告，11月16日安排公开问答，11月19日开发者会议讨论结果及可能的规格修订，且没有预先承诺决定。合约开发者应检查自身是否依赖被列出的不变量；交易者则要区分“发现问题并在测试阶段暂停”与“主网已经出事”。前者短期可能推迟升级叙事、压低情绪，也可能降低未来部署风险；最终方向取决于审计覆盖面、修订成本及新的排期，眼下不能直接算作利空落地或利好兑现。

市场反应还没有给出单一答案。我查看币安ETHUSDT时约2079美元，24小时上涨约1.90%，区间2039.44至2103.78美元；价格并未因这份已公开数日的说明持续单边下跌，但也尚未突破区间上沿。Farside记录11月10日美国现货ETH基金合计小幅净流出约130万美元，11月11日产品分项仍未齐，暂时显示的零不能读成已确认无流出。ETH短线同时受整体加密风险偏好、基金申赎与升级预期影响，不能把一根K线强行归因于四份报告。

关键位置我看2104至2110为上方确认区，站稳后才观察2140与2180；下方2050和2039是支撑。若11月13日审计显示影响面扩大或修订仍无清晰路径，而价格又跌破2039，我会推翻偏多观察；若审计结论较清楚且价格持续站稳2110，才提高反弹可信度。没有审计结果前，任何“升级恢复原排期”都只是猜测。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与追价，方向只预设条件现货做多，总资金最多2.5%。只有放量站稳2110、回踩不破，且没有新的主网安全负面公告时才分两笔入场，首笔只用计划仓位一半。2140减去至少一半，余仓目标2180；若冲高后跌回2104先减仓，跌破2050全部止损平仓。若尚未入场就先失守2039，计划取消。若审计披露的风险范围显著超出当前认知，即使价格没触及止损，我也主动清掉剩余仓位。未触发的计划只是等待，不是成交记录。

来源：以太坊基金会Glamsterdam测试说明及11月9日更新；Farside基金数据；币安ETHUSDT行情。#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

AI is still fundamentally built on computer science, mathematics, algorithms, engineering architecture, and computing infrastructure.

At the same time, other traditional industries are being deeply transformed by AI, with their production processes even being reorganized.

Many people see large numbers of programmers losing their jobs and conclude that the golden age of computer science is over. But I think this is more like an industrial transition.

In the past, programmers who wanted to bring their business ideas to life often had to rely on big tech companies for technical resources, R&D teams, funding, and infrastructure. It was difficult for one person to build a complete software product independently, but AI is changing this model of production.

In the future, a programmer may be able to use AI to do development work that once required an entire team, independently build products and run systems, or even start a software company.

Rather than seeing AI as a technology monopolized by big tech companies, we should see it as a technology that marks the computer industry's true beginnings of giving back to society.

A member of our group who studied computer science used less than $1.2 worth of tokens to flash the operating systems on more than a dozen old phones. They were simply connected to a computer with a data cable, and there was no need to keep an eye on them. What incredible productivity! It’s only a matter of time before this kind of productivity spreads across every industry…

When big tech companies lay off staff, they are freeing up programmers' productive capacity. That capacity will soon spread across industries, bringing a different kind of productivity leap to each one.

有兄弟家人要选专业，咨询我的看法，我依然推荐计算机专业，与许多人观点不同，我认为AI并不会大量消灭软件工程师，反而可能加速软件工程师向各个行业渗透，但如果选其他专业，毫无屁用。

过去几十年，软件行业主要由微软、Google、Oracle等巨头主导。技术、资本、人才、用户和基础设施高度集中，普通人想要进入这个行业，需要承担相当高的研发和商业化成本，但AI正在改变这种结构。

当软件开发、测试、维护和产品设计的成本不断下降，软件工程师就不再需要依附于传统软件公司。

懂制造业的人，可以联合软件工程师开发生产管理系统，懂金融的人，可以开发自己的风控、结算和资产管理工具，懂医疗、能源、物流的人，也可以利用AI重新设计整个行业的工作流程。

未来，软件工程师可能不再只是软件行业的从业者，而是所有行业的基础设施建设者。

我认为，软件产业未来可能出现一次组织结构上的变化。

过去是软件巨头开发产品，其他行业购买软件，再适应软件公司的产品逻辑。

未来可能是各个行业联合AI企业、软件工程师、云服务商和产业资本，共同开发适合自身需求的系统。

软件行业的竞争，也可能从单一软件巨头之间的竞争，逐渐转向多维度的产业联盟竞争。

当然，基础模型、算力、云计算和操作系统仍然可能高度集中，但应用层的软件产业会有更多参与者。

这也意味着，未来软件行业最稀缺的资源，可能不再只是编程能力，而是对真实产业的理解、行业资源、数据以及解决实际问题的能力。

我十二三岁时就有机会跳进大学选择计算机专业，但我没有坚持自己的想法，现在想一想依然是一种遗憾…

Some family members with siblings are choosing a major and asked for my opinion. I still recommend computer science. Contrary to what many people think, I don’t believe AI will eliminate software engineers in large numbers. Instead, it may accelerate their spread into every industry. But if you choose some other major, it’ll be completely useless.

For the past few decades, the software industry has been dominated by giants like Microsoft, Google, and Oracle. Technology, capital, talent, users, and infrastructure have been highly concentrated. For ordinary people to enter the industry, the costs of research and development and commercialization have been quite high. But AI is changing this structure.

As the costs of software development, testing, maintenance, and product design continue to fall, software engineers will no longer need to rely on traditional software companies.

People who understand manufacturing can work with software engineers to develop production management systems. Those who understand finance can build their own tools for risk management, settlements, and asset management. People in healthcare, energy, and logistics can also use AI to redesign workflows across their industries.

In the future, software engineers may no longer work only in the software industry; they may become builders of essential infrastructure for every industry.

I think the software industry may undergo a structural change in how it is organized.

In the past, software giants developed products, other industries bought the software, and then adapted to the logic of the software companies’ products.

In the future, different industries may work with AI companies, software engineers, cloud service providers, and industrial investors to jointly develop systems suited to their needs.

Competition in the software industry may also gradually shift from competition between individual software giants to competition between multidimensional industry alliances.

Of course, foundation models, computing power, cloud computing, and operating systems may still remain highly concentrated, but the application software industry will have more participants.

This also means that the scarcest resources in the software industry may no longer be just programming skills, but also an understanding of real-world industries, industry connections, data, and the ability to solve practical problems.

When I was twelve or thirteen, I had the chance to skip ahead to university and study computer science, but I didn’t stick with my own idea. Looking back now, I still regret it…

I have been watching the liquidation feeds roll across my screens all morning after a brutal $913 million forced long wipeout shook the market to its core, and the psychological divide between retail traders and Wall Street institutions has never looked wider. 
Bitcoin dominance has marched up to 60.5%, sucking the oxygen out of the altcoin room and leaving everyone asking if capital is permanently abandoning the Layer-1 giants. Over the past 30 days, Ethereum ($ETH ) has bled out nearly 17% to 20% and Solana ($SOL ) has dropped 23% to 26%, pushing both charts straight onto the edge of psychological cliffs that have traders frozen in fear. 
If you know how I approach this market, you already know I do not trade based on timeline panic. When you strip away the leveraged washouts and look directly at the institutional plumbing being installed behind the scenes, a completely different story emerges—one where Wall Street banks and brokerage titans are quietly opening the floodgates while ETF tourists sprint for the exits.
Let us break down what is actually happening inside the Ethereum ($ETH ) machine, because the battle around the $2,000 psychological fortress is the ultimate test of conviction. Right now, $ETH is changing hands around $2,050 to $2,054 after six straight weeks of downward pressure, trading beneath both its 50-week and 200-week moving averages. 
The near-term culprit is right there in the fund flow data: U.S. spot Ether ETFs just logged $184.6 million in net outflows—marking their third consecutive day of withdrawals, led by $119.3 million exiting BlackRock’s ETHA. 
Yet, while ETF paper hands are selling into weakness, global banking giant Standard Chartered officially expanded its institutional prime brokerage access to Ether via the 24X platform, acting as the central counterparty so major institutions can execute ETH and FX trades under one roof. At the protocol level, Paradigm’s Reth team just rolled out the Reth v2.10.0 state root security patch to harden node infrastructure, while core developers are pushing toward the Glamsterdam Base Layer Scaling Upgrade—which introduces block-level access lists for parallel execution alongside a raised 60M default gas limit. 
My technical roadmap for $ETH is straightforward: options markets are pricing in an 8.5% volatility swing, and bulls must defend the $2,000 floor at all costs. 
If $2,000 holds and absorbs this ETF outflow wave, we have a clean mean-reversion setup; however, if a daily candle snaps cleanly below $2,000, prepare your dry powder for a liquidity sweep down to the August low of $1,874, with the one-year floor sitting deep at $1,566.
Now, shift your focus to Solana ($SOL), where the contrast between depressed price action and mind-blowing network dominance is arguably even more extreme. 
On the chart, $SOL has taken a beating, trading between $82.50 and $85—sitting 8.3% below its 200-day moving average ($89) and 16.8% below its 20-day average ($96), pressured by $7.7 million in spot Solana ETF outflows and lingering regulatory scrutiny out of Asia. 
Retail sees an asset down 72% from its cycle peak and assumes the ecosystem is dying. Meanwhile, Fidelity Digital Assets just dropped a bombshell report revealing that Solana’s weekly trade count officially surpassed the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE), capturing a staggering 15% of major U.S. exchange flows (up from just 0.30% in 2022)! On top of that, Charles Schwab now lets clients trade Solana, Galaxy and Exodus shares are slated to trade directly on Solana’s rails, and the network’s new Privacy Rings launch is bringing institutional-grade confidentiality to high-speed DeFi. Right now, $SOL is locked inside a make-or-break trading band between $79.69 and $86.73, with options traders pricing in a 9.3% move. 
If bulls defend the $80 round-number support and reclaim the 200-day average at $89, momentum flips rapidly back toward $96. 
But if $80 gives way on a daily close, the trapdoor opens straight to the August close at $75, with the ultimate one-year macro floor waiting at $62.
How am I navigating this bloodbath across my own portfolio while Bitcoin dominance hovers near 61%? I am treating 2,000 onETH and 80 onSOL as the two most important line-in-the-sand battlegrounds in crypto right now. 
When Standard Chartered builds prime brokerage rails for Ethereum and Solana out-trades the New York Stock Exchange while retail is getting liquidated out of leveraged longs, you are watching a textbook transfer of assets from impatient speculators to long-term infrastructure giants. 
I am not trying to catch a falling knife with high leverage; instead, I am setting staggered spot limit orders right at these structural support zones and waiting for ETF outflows to exhaust themselves before sizing up.
I want to hear from the real survivors in my community down in the comments: If you had to deploy fresh capital at these exact support levels, are you backing Ethereum’s $2,000 fortress with Standard Chartered stepping in, or Solana’s $80 battleground after out-trading the NYSE—or are you waiting for $1,874 ETH and $75 SOL?

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | When You Hold On to a Losing Trade, Your Brain Is Deceiving You
translatedData.subTitle:
What does someone down 50% on an unrealized position focus on? The “all-time high,” thinking: “If it gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” Remember, this thought is all fixation and no logic. The market doesn’t know your entry price;
it only cares about supply and demand right now.

Once you’re stuck holding a position, you automatically collect bullish news and block out bearish news. This is called confirmation bias. You’ll think,
“This time is different.” Those five words have cost more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The cure is actually simple, but hard to follow: before opening a position, write down “under what circumstances the logic behind this trade
will no longer hold,” then act when the time comes, regardless of how you feel. Separate your decisions from your positions, and you’ll be able to see clearly

Some family members with siblings are choosing a major and asked for my opinion. I still recommend computer science. Contrary to what many people think, I don’t believe AI will eliminate software engineers in large numbers. Instead, it may accelerate their spread into every industry. But if you choose some other major, it’ll be completely useless.

For the past few decades, the software industry has been dominated by giants like Microsoft, Google, and Oracle. Technology, capital, talent, users, and infrastructure have been highly concentrated. For ordinary people to enter the industry, the costs of research and development and commercialization have been quite high. But AI is changing this structure.

As the costs of software development, testing, maintenance, and product design continue to fall, software engineers will no longer need to rely on traditional software companies.

People who understand manufacturing can work with software engineers to develop production management systems. Those who understand finance can build their own tools for risk management, settlements, and asset management. People in healthcare, energy, and logistics can also use AI to redesign workflows across their industries.

In the future, software engineers may no longer work only in the software industry; they may become builders of essential infrastructure for every industry.

I think the software industry may undergo a structural change in how it is organized.

In the past, software giants developed products, other industries bought the software, and then adapted to the logic of the software companies’ products.

In the future, different industries may work with AI companies, software engineers, cloud service providers, and industrial investors to jointly develop systems suited to their needs.

Competition in the software industry may also gradually shift from competition between individual software giants to competition between multidimensional industry alliances.

Of course, foundation models, computing power, cloud computing, and operating systems may still remain highly concentrated, but the application software industry will have more participants.

This also means that the scarcest resources in the software industry may no longer be just programming skills, but also an understanding of real-world industries, industry connections, data, and the ability to solve practical problems.

When I was twelve or thirteen, I had the chance to skip ahead to university and study computer science, but I didn’t stick with my own idea. Looking back now, I still regret it…

过去几十年，软件行业主要由微软、Google、Oracle等巨头主导。技术、资本、人才、用户和基础设施高度集中，普通人想要进入这个行业，需要承担相当高的研发和商业化成本，但AI正在改变这种结构。

当软件开发、测试、维护和产品设计的成本不断下降，软件工程师就不再需要依附于传统软件公司。

懂制造业的人，可以联合软件工程师开发生产管理系统，懂金融的人，可以开发自己的风控、结算和资产管理工具，懂医疗、能源、物流的人，也可以利用AI重新设计整个行业的工作流程。

未来，软件工程师可能不再只是软件行业的从业者，而是所有行业的基础设施建设者。

过去是软件巨头开发产品，其他行业购买软件，再适应软件公司的产品逻辑。

一、以太坊价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十一月十一日，以太坊现货价格报两千零九十一美元，过去二十四小时内上涨约百分之二点四，价格从两千零二十八美元附近反弹至两千零九十一美元。从一小时K线数据来看，最近五根蜡烛同样呈现逐步走高的态势，开盘价从两千零五十八美元上涨至两千零九十一美元，其中第二根蜡烛放量上涨，成交额达到四千零二十三万美元，为近期最大单小时成交量，显示出多头资金在关键位置的积极介入。

以太坊本轮反弹的核心驱动力来自三个方面。第一，德意志银行在欧洲推出数字资产托管服务，明确支持以太坊托管，为机构投资者提供了合规的入场通道。第二，链上数据显示包括七兄弟在内的多个大户实体累计买入一万零七百九十二枚以太坊，加上早期ICO持有者的增持行为，有效吸收了市场流通筹码。第三，小时级别净流入资金达到一千七百七十五万美元，交易量突破一亿四千五百万美元，量价齐升的格局为价格反弹提供了有力支撑。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七日移动均线报两千零七十一美元，二十五日均线报两千零六十一美元，价格已经站上所有短周期均线上方，短线多头排列格局确立。但九十九日均线位于两千一百三十七美元，距离当前价格仍有约百分之二的空间，构成中期上方的重要阻力位。指数移动均线显示七日EMA报两千零七十六美元，价格运行在短期EMA上方，但距离九十九日EMA两千一百二十七美元仍有较大差距。

布林带指标显示上轨位于两千零八十六美元，中轨位于两千零六十三美元，下轨位于两千零四十美元。当前价格已经突破布林带上轨，短期内存在回踩中轨的技术需求。MACD指标方面，MACD线报零点七四，信号线报负四点八九，柱状图连续放大至五点六四，MACD线即将上穿信号线形成金叉，这是短期看涨的积极信号。

RSI指标方面，六周期RSI报七十六点八五，已经进入明显的超买区域，十二周期RSI报六十二点九五，二十四周期RSI报五十一点六六，与比特币类似，短周期超买而中长周期偏中性。KDJ指标中K值六十八点三六、D值五十九点三五、J值八十六点三八，J值同样处于高位区域。随机RSI指标达到九十八点九，接近极端超买。ATR指标报十七点八四，波动率处于适中水平。威廉指标报负二十二点九，处于超买区域。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场当前面临多空博弈加剧的局面。技术因子统计显示，十五个因子中七个看涨、七个看跌、一个中性，与比特币完全一致，反映出整个加密市场在宏观不确定性下的犹豫态度。综合指标信号为看跌，历史胜率为百分之七十点零五，统计上更倾向于短期调整。

风险因素方面，美国CPI数据超预期引发的加息预期对以太坊构成持续压力，比特币现货ETF的连续赎回也拖累了整个市场的情绪。以太坊基金会近期通过去中心化交易所减持了约两千枚以太坊，增加了现货市场的抛压。此外，鲸鱼地址在过去一段时间内抛售了一万七千八百枚以太坊，与比特币鲸鱼的减仓行为形成共振。

但中长期来看，以太坊的生态基本面依然稳健。代币化股票市场的流通供应量突破四十亿美元创历史新高，其中以太坊链占据了重要份额。纽约证券交易所选择Avalanche进行代币化证券平台建设的消息虽然与以太坊直接相关性有限，但整体而言传统金融与区块链的融合趋势对以太坊生态构成长期利好。高盛和花旗支持的稳定币项目也为以太坊上的DeFi生态带来了更多想象空间。

热门代币方面，SNXXB当前报价四点六二美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之三十八点三二；MUUB报价十九点二七美元，涨幅百分之三十二点一七；MVLLB报价十二点七三美元，涨幅百分之二十八点零七。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A Stop Loss Isn't Admitting You're Wrong—It's a Ticket to Your Next Opportunity
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people can't bring themselves to take a stop loss because they treat it as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
can't get past it. Look at it another way: a stop loss is insurance you've bought in advance, and the premium is that small loss.
The difference between a professional and a gambler isn't who gets it right more often, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The steadiest traders I've seen cut their losses more decisively than anyone when they're wrong. Because they know: whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn't matter; what matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. The next time your hand trembles as you take a stop loss, tell yourself
this is a ticket, not a verdict.

translatedData.content:
A brother asked whether U.S. Treasury debt might blow up.

I’ve actually answered this question many times.

One of the most effective ways for a government to manage debt is to keep issuing it, letting it circulate within the financial system, then channeling the funds back into society through government spending, industrial investment, and capital markets to create new industries and economic growth.

Volatility in the debt market is normal, but I don’t think U.S. Treasury debt will easily suffer a default in the traditional sense.

That’s because the global economy today has long since become a highly interconnected debt system. Everyone has debt problems; no one is unaffected.

The U.S. has its debt, and China has its debt too.

Our government has money, but local governments, state-owned enterprises, and private companies also carry a great deal of debt. Ample funds on the government’s balance sheet don’t mean that the economy as a whole has no liquidity or debt pressures.

At its core, the underlying code of a modern economy is credit expansion, debt financing, capital reallocation, and industrial growth.

What’s really worth worrying about has never been the total amount of debt itself, but whether new debt can create enough productive capacity, and whether economic growth can cover rising financing costs.

Ordinary people at the bottom of society are crying out that they’re poor. The core reason is that the government is unwilling to take on debt and lacks confidence in its own future. In a few years, we’ll realize that it’s perfectly normal for a government to borrow. Given the current state of the domestic economy, the government will sooner or later take on a lot of debt. There’s no point in the central bank holding huge cash reserves. In a sense, those reserves are continually losing value. For example, continually stockpiling gold at high prices serves little purpose for the government…

One day, we’ll realize that they’ll restart debt expansion. Globally speaking, although U.S. debt is large in absolute terms, it’s still relatively modest compared with the size of the U.S. economy.

By contrast, our debt is tangled and difficult to quantify precisely. Household debt, corporate debt, government debt, and debt held by state-owned enterprises are all mixed together—hard to sort out or make sense of.

content:
有兄弟聊，美债会不会爆。

这个问题其实回答过很多次。

政府管理债务最有效的方式之一，就是持续发债，让债务在金融体系内滚动，再通过财政支出、产业投资和资本市场，把资金重新输送回社会，创造新的产业和经济增长。

债务市场出现波动很正常，但我不认为美债会轻易出现传统意义上的偿付暴雷。

因为今天全球经济早已形成高度关联的债务体系，大家都有债务问题，谁也不是独善其身。

美国有美国的债务，中国也有中国的债务。

我们政府有钱，但地方政府、国央企、民营企业同样背负着大量债务。政府资产负债表上的资金充裕，并不意味着整个经济体系没有流动性和债务压力。

现代经济的底层代码，本质上就是信用扩张、债务融资、资本再配置和产业增长。

真正值得担心的，从来不是债务总量本身，而是新增债务能不能创造足够的生产力，以及经济增长能不能覆盖不断上升的融资成本。

国内底层人民嗷嗷叫穷，核心原因政府不愿意背负债务，政府对自身未来也不够自信。再过些年会发现，政府背债是一件很正常的事情。以目前国内经济形势，政府迟早会背大量的债务，央行大量储蓄现金没有任何意义，某一个层面讲央行的储蓄在持续贬值，比如高价持续囤积黄金，政府持续囤金意义不大…

总有一天会发现，它们还会重启债务扩张。在全球看，美国债务虽然数字很大，但相对自己的经济规模而言还是较轻。

反而我们债务错综复杂，难以具体的统计。家庭债务、企业债务、政府债务、央国企债务乱七八糟，捋不清，道不明。

$ETH: When One Indicator Calls the Shot

$ETH: ETH shows an up hourly direction while trading above resistance and volume sits at 3.22x baseline. Does a single metric like volume justify a confident trade decision? The question invites a deeper look at how liquidity signals can be misread.

A useful analogy is to compare market volume to a river's surface flow. A high surface speed suggests strong current, yet the river may have hidden eddies that slow overall progress. In crypto terms, a spike in relative volume can reflect a burst of short‑term activity, but it does not guarantee that deeper order book depth or true liquidity has improved. Traders might interpret the surface surge as a sign of lasting momentum, while the underlying order flow could be thin and prone to reversal.

The observation provides a concrete scenario: an up direction, price above resistance, and elevated volume. A counterexample would be a token that repeatedly shows similar volume bursts yet fails to sustain price, indicating that volume alone is insufficient. To reassess, monitor the next closed hourly candle for a change in RSI 72.4 or a shift in price relative to the local support level. If price retreats while volume normalises, the initial conclusion about strong liquidity would need to be revised.

By treating volume as one piece of a broader puzzle, analysts avoid the trap of jumping to conclusions based on a single indicator.

Probabilistic market research, not a recommendation or guaranteed return.

The comparison to keep in mind: $BTC has hourly direction up and volume above its baseline; $SOXLB has hourly direction up and volume above its baseline. This alone does not establish correlation.

Bitmine holds 6.07 million ETH, or 4.97% of the total supply, yet the falling price has left it with a net loss of $6.3 billion. The numbers are hard to ignore: even whales feel the pain. Once unrealized losses hit the balance sheet, it’s time to rethink the conviction.

I’m watching two signals: net exchange flows and active addresses. Rising net inflows while address activity fails to keep pace with the surge in volume usually points to a reshuffling of positions. Continued net outflows alongside a recovery in address activity looks more like demand returning. Price acts out the sentiment first; on-chain data reveals what’s underneath later.

Deutsche Bank offers crypto custody to businesses and institutions. ETH can be stored and transferred, sparing clients the need to build their own wallets and manage private keys—a sound proposition. - Short term: The volatility triggered by the CPI release shows that the market remains sensitive to Fed rate hikes, but Bitcoin’s resilience under pressure has also been put to the test. - Medium term: If the Fed subsequently shifts to a dovish stance, the area above $74K could become an important support level for Bitcoin. However, it’s important to monitor changes in global risk sentiment, especially the impact of Treasury yield movements on capital flows.

My take
Bitcoin has shown strong support above $74K, potentially opening up room for short-term gains. However, given global inflationary pressures and uncertainty around Fed policy, $75K remains a key resistance level. Investors should be wary of short-term volatility, but in the long run, Bitcoin’s performance following the CPI data suggests it still has upside potential.

Michael Saylor proposes paying dividends with Bitcoin unrealized gains to help investors reduce their tax burden. What impact could this model have on BTC?

Michael Saylor, the big-shot Bitcoin miner behind MicroStrategy, is cooking up another new idea. He says Strategy could pay dividends using the appreciation in the Bitcoin it holds (the portion it hasn't sold), and thanks to a tax loophole in U.S. law called a “return of capital,” investors may not have to pay taxes right away. Put simply, you receive dividends from Bitcoin's gains without paying income tax for now, and settle up later when you sell Bitcoin at a loss. This is certainly an enticing approach, especially for investment institutions that value cash flow.

Market impact
🎯 In the short term, this model could make Bitcoin more attractive, especially to investors interested in earning income from Bitcoin dividends, much like stock dividends. For example, pension funds and mutual funds, which generally aren't keen on investing directly in crypto, could face a lower barrier to entry thanks to this tax-saving approach. The medium-term potential is even greater: if the market widely embraces this model, it could inspire new ideas across the crypto industry about how financial instruments can make it easier for ordinary people to access and hold Bitcoin. Regulatory trends will also be closely watched, as U.S. tax authorities' treatment of this kind of arrangement remains an open question. If regulators don't object, that would be bullish for Bitcoin.

My take
If this strategy takes off, it could help clear bearish pressure on BTC. In the short term, it could indeed attract some capital inflows, but in the long run, Bitcoin's value as a holding still depends more on its potential price appreciation than on dividends. BTC is currently at $73,412, with significant resistance overhead. If this model can help push the price above $80K, then it will have proved its effectiveness. The risk is that the market may see this as just a short-term gimmick, or that the tax benefits turn out to be less impressive than advertised. Don't be too hard on me if I'm wrong; I'm only trying it with a small position myself.

content:
Michael Saylor 提出用比特币未实现收益搞分红，帮助投资者避税，这个模式到底对 BTC 有啥影响。

Michael Saylor 那个搞 MicroStrategy 的矿工大佬，又在鼓捣新花样了。他说 Strategy 公司可以拿手里的比特币升值部分（就是没卖的部分）来发分红，而且因为美国税法里有个「return of capital」的骚操作，投资者可以暂时不用交税。说白了就是，你拿了比特币涨的钱分红，暂时不用交所得税，等以后卖比特币亏钱了再补回来。这招确实挺诱惑人的，尤其是那些看重现金流的投资机构。

对市场的影响
🎯 短期看，这个模式可能会让比特币的吸引力增加，尤其是对比特币分红这种像股票一样收息的玩法感兴趣的资金。比如养老基金、共同基金这种，本来就不太会直接干加密，但分红避税这招能降低他们参与的门槛。中期的可能性更大，如果这个模式被市场广泛接受，可能会给整个加密货币行业带来新思路——怎么通过金融工具让普通人更容易接触和持有比特币。监管趋势这块，美国税法对这类行为的认定会持续被关注，如果官方不反对，那利好比特币。

我的判断
这个策略如果能落地，对 BTC 有利空出清的效应。短期内，确实能吸引一部分资金流入，但长期看，比特币的持有价值更多还是在于潜在价格上涨，而不是分红。目前 BTC 在 $73,412 这个位置，上方阻力比较大，如果这个模式能推动价格突破到 $80K 以上，那才算真正有效。风险是市场可能觉得这只是短期噱头，或者最终发现避税效果不如宣传的那么好。说错轻喷，我自己也就小仓位试试。

[FSB abruptly warns Turkey: If crypto regulation doesn’t catch up, major problems could arise,]

The FSB warns Turkey to tighten crypto regulation, affecting the country’s cryptocurrency industry.

The Financial Stability Board (FSB) recently sent Turkey a “follow-up” notice. What’s the FSB? It’s a think tank for the world’s financial heavyweights. They’ve noticed that Turkey has been slow to issue crypto licenses, and are urging it to hurry up and tighten oversight before risks get out of control. More than 100 crypto companies in Turkey still don’t have licenses, representing half of the country’s crypto industry. The FSB recommends that Turkey not only speed up license issuance but also strengthen regulatory enforcement and coordinate with other countries to follow the same rules. After all, cryptocurrencies move across borders, so managing things well on your own isn’t enough.

Market impact
- Short term: Recommendations from an international body like the FSB mainly affect sentiment in Turkey’s domestic market. But honestly, Turkey’s crypto industry is currently being sustained largely by enthusiasm, and it’s hard to say whether a sudden regulatory clampdown could trigger liquidity problems.
- Medium term: This highlights the complexity of global crypto regulation. The FSB wants countries to coordinate with one another, but in practice, each country has its own pace and interests. In the long run, the growing calls to “strengthen regulation” will push projects to focus more on compliance. But whether this will create new barriers to entry for the industry is too early to say.

My take
The FSB’s recommendation to Turkey this time feels more like a “standards reminder” than a hard-line measure to “shut things down immediately.” The industry is now transitioning from a period of unchecked growth to more orderly development. As these calls grow more frequent, the overall trend is toward greater regulation, but countries are still figuring out how and when to do it. Take this with a grain of salt—I’m just testing the waters with a small position to see how this sentiment-driven move plays out.

[FSB突然警告土耳其：加密监管再不跟上，可能要出大问题，]

FSB警告土耳其要强加密监管，土耳其加密货币行业受影响。

金融稳定委员会（FSB）最近给土耳其发了张"催单"通知。FSB是啥？就是全球金融大佬们的智囊团，他们发现土耳其在加密货币牌照发这个事儿上有点慢，就提醒说：得快点，再不严起来，风险可能失控。土耳其现在有100多家加密公司拿不到牌照，这批公司占了该国加密行业的一半。FSB建议土耳其不仅要赶紧发牌照，还得加强监管执行，跟其他国家一起玩规矩游戏。毕竟加密货币这东西，跨境流动多，光自己管好还不够。

对市场的影响
- 短期：FSB这种国际组织的建议，主要影响的是土耳其本土市场情绪。但说实话，现在土耳其加密行业主要靠热情撑着，监管突然收紧，会不会引发流动性问题，还真不好说。
- 中期：这个事儿反应出全球加密监管的复杂性。FSB希望各国能互相配合，但实际操作中，每个国家都有自己的节奏和利益。对行业长期格局来说，这种"加强监管"的声音越来越多，会逼着项目方更注重合规，但会不会变成新的行业壁垒，现在下定论还为时过早。

我的判断
FSB这次建议土耳其更像是一个"标准提醒"，不是那种"马上关闸"的强硬措施。行业现在正处于野蛮生长到规范发展的过渡期，这种声音多了，整体趋势是更规范了，但具体怎么规范、何时规范，各国还在摸索中。说错轻喷，我自己也就小仓位试试这波情绪波动。

ETH Watch | ARK Files for 14 Thematic Funds | Tokenization Is Not the Same as Spot Buying

My view is to pay attention to institutional frameworks and product design, but not to chase ETH based on a headline for now. Binance Square is discussing ARK’s plan to launch 14 thematic ETFs, the most directly relevant to the crypto market being the proposed “Tokenization Market Infrastructure ETF.” I checked the preliminary prospectus filed with the U.S. SEC by ARK ETF Trust on November 6: the document does list 14 proposed products, and clearly states that the information is incomplete and the products may not yet be sold; fees and ticker symbols are still blank. The filing is a fact; approval, listing, inflows, and ETH purchases are not.

The investment pathway matters more. The proposed fund includes companies such as tokenization platforms, stablecoin issuers, exchanges, custodians, and settlement networks in its research scope, and also mentions U.S.-listed products related to native blockchain assets such as Ether and SOL. But the prospectus also states that the fund will not directly hold digital assets or these crypto ETPs; it may gain exposure to related returns through total return swaps, and expects to implement its strategy primarily through swaps and shares of related companies. This means that growing institutional interest in “on-chain market infrastructure” may first benefit listed companies, financial products, and service providers, with actual on-chain usage then potentially feeding through to ETH demand. A prospectus filing should not be translated into “ARK is buying Ethereum now.”

The market reaction also does not support rushing to price in the news. At the time of this check, Binance ETH/USDT was around $2,048.82, down about 1.03% over 24 hours, with a high of $2,103.78 and a low of $2,035.83. Although ETH was marked as a Rapid Riser in Square’s six-hour Most Searched list, a surge in searches does not equal net buying; the price remains near the lower half of its range. The levels I’m watching are whether it can reclaim and hold above $2,104, and whether it can hold around $2,036. If the fund documents take effect and disclose actual holdings and creations and redemptions, I’ll reassess the real flow of capital; for now, all of this remains hypothetical.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t participate now; my only tentative bias would be a small spot long. I would enter a test position using 3% of total capital only if the hourly candle closes above $2,104, the price holds above $2,090 on a retest, and there are no new negative security or regulatory announcements. I’d take half off at the first target of $2,140, then half of the remaining position at the second target of $2,180. I’d close the rest if the hourly price falls back below $2,104. The initial stop-loss would be $2,070, with an immediate exit if hit; if the price first breaks below $2,036, I’d cancel the entire long setup. Conditions that would invalidate my view include a sustained breakdown in price, revisions to the filing that reduce crypto exposure, or actual product progress falling short of expectations. Keeping the narrative separate from actual trading is what keeps position sizing disciplined.

Sources: ARK ETF Trust’s preliminary prospectus filed with the SEC on November 6; public Binance ETH/USDT market data.

ETH观察｜ARK申请14只主题基金｜代币化概念不等于现货买盘

我的态度是关注制度和产品设计，但暂不因标题追ETH。币安广场正在讨论ARK计划推出14只主题ETF，其中与加密市场最直接相关的是拟议的“代币化市场基础设施ETF”。我核对了ARK ETF Trust在11月6日提交美国SEC的初步招募说明书：这份文件确实列出14只拟议产品，也明确写着资料尚未完成、产品尚不得销售；费用和交易代码仍留空。提交文件是事实，获批上市、资金流入和买入ETH都还不是事实。

更关键的是投资路径。该拟议基金把代币化平台、稳定币发行方、交易所、托管和结算网络等公司纳入研究范围，也提到与Ether、SOL等原生链资产相关的美国上市产品。但招募书同时写明，基金不会直接持有数字资产，也不会直接持有这些加密ETP；它可能通过总收益互换取得相关收益敞口，且预期主要借助互换和相关公司股票实施策略。这意味着机构对“链上市场基础设施”的兴趣增加，受益路径可能先落在上市公司、金融产品和服务商，再由真实链上使用量传导到ETH需求。不能把一份申请书翻译成“ARK现在买入以太坊”。

市场反应也不支持急着给消息定价。本轮查看币安ETH/USDT约2048.82美元，24小时跌约1.03%，高点2103.78、低点2035.83。ETH虽在广场六小时Most Searched里标为Rapid Riser，搜索升温并不等于净买盘；价格仍靠近区间下半部。我的观察位是2104上方能否重新站稳，以及2036附近能否守住。若后续基金文件生效、披露实际持仓和申赎，再评估真实资金传导；目前都还在设想阶段。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向仅预设现货小仓做多。只有小时线收上2104美元，回踩2090美元不失，并且没有新的负面安全或监管公告，才用总资金的3%试单。第一目标2140美元减半，第二目标2180美元再减剩余仓位的一半，余仓小时线跌回2104美元下方全部平仓。初始止损设在2070美元，触及即离场；如果先跌破2036美元，取消整套做多计划。判断被推翻的条件包括价格持续破位、申请文件被修改为更弱的加密敞口，或实际产品进度不及预期。把叙事和成交分开，仓位才有纪律。

来源：ARK ETF Trust提交SEC的11月6日初步招募书、币安ETH/USDT公开行情。
